descriptionByLocale.it:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior IT Project Manager

Warsaw | up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8154

Are you passionate about steering enterprise-wide IT initiatives across their full lifecycle—reducing complexity, increasing resilience, and delivering measurable business value? We are seeking a Senior IT Project Manager for our Corporate Function IT (CIT) to lead international, cross-functional projects in infrastructure , operations , compliance, and security in an international team. You will drive migrations, modernizations, and harmonization programs, establish robust governance, and help the organization sustainably adopt standards and new solutions.

What You Will Do

• lead and deliver complex end-to-end IT projects across infrastructure, operations, compliance, and security in regulated environments

• plan and execute migrations, decommissioning, and cutovers, ensuring data integrity, integrations, and risk control

• establish and enforce governance, audit, and security standards; provide transparent steering and management reporting

• drive stakeholder engagement, change management, training, and communication to enable adoption and standardization

• coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors; prepare decision papers and materials for boards and committees

What You Bring

• 10+ years of IT project management experience (ideally in financial or other regulated environments) with proven delivery in infrastructure, compliance, and operations

• certifications in PRINCE2, PMP, IPMA or equivalent; strong, pragmatic use of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) in hybrid setups

• proficiency with Jira/Confluence, Jira Service Management, Office 365, Planisware, and risk management tools; familiarity with BMC ITSM Suite, Enterprise Architect, access management, and firewall/network tools

• excellent analytical and conceptual skills with structured problem-solving, clear communication, and strong stakeholder/change management; high initiative, organization, and assertiveness with empathy and EQ

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Analisi dei dati

Varsavia | Fino al 40% di lavoro da casa possibile | Riferimento 8128

In qualità di Data Analyst, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave nel garantire l'accuratezza, la stabilità e l'affidabilità dei nostri processi di dati. Questa posizione è ideale per chi ama lavorare con set di dati complessi, collaborare con gli stakeholder e risolvere le sfide tecniche con una mentalità strutturata e analitica. Se siete motivati, curiosi e desiderosi di contribuire a operazioni di dati di alta qualità, questo ruolo offre una grande opportunità per crescere e fare un impatto.

Cosa farai

• eseguire onboarding tecnico dei fornitori di dati di fondo, tra cui l'analisi dei file, la configurazione di mappatura, test e distribuzione di produzione

• monitorare e gestire le consegne dei dati, assicurando il corretto trattamento e mantenendo le regole di invio della casella di posta

• coordinare con gli stakeholder per chiarire i requisiti e sostenere le attività di bordo e di funzionamento

• indagare e risolvere i dati, mappatura e problemi tecnici, escalation casi complessi quando richiesto

• monitorare l'elaborazione quotidiana e le eccezioni in DataHub, Xceptor e sistemi correlati per garantire la stabilità operativa

• mantenere i dati di qualità e di riferimento, tra cui mappature di classe di condivisione, classificazioni di asset e analisi di copertura

Che cosa porta

• laurea o diploma di istruzione superiore in finanza, economia o informatica e almeno 1 anno di esperienza lavorativa nei servizi finanziari

• buona conoscenza dei mercati finanziari e degli strumenti finanziari

• analitico, metodologico, tecnico, problem solving competenze sono una forza chiave

• motivato, inquisitivo e organizzato giocatore di squadra con uno spirito "può fare"

• eccellenti capacità verbali e scritte in inglese

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero +48 538 562 645

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Data Analyst

Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8128

As a Data Analyst , you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, stability, and reliability of our data processes. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working with complex datasets, collaborating with stakeholders, and solving technical challenges with a structured, analytical mindset. If you’re motivated, curious, and eager to contribute to high‑quality data operations, this role offers a great opportunity to grow and make an impact.

What You Will Do

• perform technical onboarding of fund data providers, including file analysis, mapping configuration, testing, and production deployment

• monitor and manage data deliveries, ensuring successful processing and maintaining mailbox forwarding rules

• coordinate with stakeholders to clarify requirements and support onboarding and operational activities

• investigate and resolve data, mapping, and technical issues, escalating complex cases when required

• monitor daily processing and exceptions in DataHub, Xceptor, and related systems to ensure operational stability

• maintain data quality and reference data, including share class mappings, asset classifications, and coverage analysis

What You Bring

• bachelor’s or higher education degree in Finance, Economics or Computer Science and at least 1 year of working experience in financial services

• good knowledge of financial markets and securities instruments

• analytical, methodological, technical, problem-solving skills are a key strength

• motivated, inquisitive and organized team player with a "can do” spirit

• excellent verbal and written skills in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Datenanalyst

Warschau | Bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus arbeiten möglich | Referenz 8128

Als Data Analyst spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gewährleistung der Genauigkeit, Stabilität und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Datenprozesse. Diese Position ist ideal für jemanden, der gerne mit komplexen Datensätzen arbeitet, mit Stakeholdern zusammenarbeitet und technische Herausforderungen mit einer strukturierten, analytischen Denkweise löst. Wenn Sie motiviert, neugierig und eifrig sind, zu qualitativ hochwertigen Datenoperationen beizutragen, bietet diese Rolle eine großartige Gelegenheit, zu wachsen und etwas zu bewirken.

Was Sie tun werden

• Führen Sie das technische Onboarding von Fondsdatenanbietern durch, einschließlich Dateianalyse, Zuordnungskonfiguration, Tests und Bereitstellung der Produktion

• Überwachung und Verwaltung der Datenlieferungen, Gewährleistung einer erfolgreichen Verarbeitung und Aufrechterhaltung der Regeln für die Postfachweiterleitung

• Koordination mit Stakeholdern zur Klärung von Anforderungen und Unterstützung von Onboarding und operativen Aktivitäten

• Untersuchung und Lösung von Daten, Mapping und technischen Problemen, bei Bedarf Eskalation komplexer Fälle

• Überwachung der täglichen Verarbeitung und Ausnahmen in DataHub, Xceptor und verwandten Systemen zur Gewährleistung der Betriebsstabilität

• Aufrechterhaltung der Datenqualität und Referenzdaten, einschließlich Share-Class-Mappings, Asset-Klassifizierungen und Coverage-Analysen

Was du mitbringst

• Bachelor- oder Hochschulabschluss in Finanzen, Wirtschaft oder Informatik und mindestens 1 Jahr Berufserfahrung in Finanzdienstleistungen

• gute Kenntnisse der Finanzmärkte und Wertpapierinstrumente

• analytische, methodische, technische, problemlösende Fähigkeiten sind eine Schlüsselstärke

• motivierter, neugieriger und organisierter Teamplayer mit einem "Can Do" -Geist

• ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Fähigkeiten in Englisch

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa unter +48 538 562 645 an

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste des données

Varsovie: jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible

En tant qu'analyste de données, vous jouerez un rôle clé pour assurer la précision, la stabilité et la fiabilité de nos processus de données. Cette position est idéale pour quelqu'un qui aime travailler avec des ensembles de données complexes, collaborer avec les intervenants et résoudre les défis techniques avec un état d'esprit structuré et analytique. Si vous êtes motivé, curieux et désireux de contribuer à des opérations de données de haute qualité, ce rôle offre une excellente occasion de grandir et d'avoir un impact.

Ce que vous ferez

• effectuer l'embarquement technique des fournisseurs de données du fonds, y compris l'analyse des fichiers, la configuration des cartes, les essais et le déploiement de la production

• surveiller et gérer les livraisons de données, assurer le traitement efficace et maintenir les règles de transmission des boîtes aux lettres

• coordonner avec les parties prenantes pour clarifier les exigences et l'appui aux activités de bord et opérationnelles

• enquêter sur les données, la cartographie et les problèmes techniques et les résoudre, en augmentant les cas complexes au besoin

• surveiller le traitement quotidien et les exceptions dans DataHub, Xceptor et les systèmes connexes pour assurer la stabilité opérationnelle

• maintenir la qualité des données et les données de référence, y compris la cartographie des classes de parts, la classification des actifs et l'analyse de la couverture;

Ce que vous apportez

• Licence ou diplôme d'études supérieures en finance, économie ou informatique et au moins 1 an d'expérience dans les services financiers

• bonne connaissance des marchés financiers et des instruments de valeurs mobilières

• Les compétences analytiques, méthodologiques, techniques et en résolution de problèmes constituent une force clé

• motivé, curieux et organisé joueur d'équipe avec un "peut faire" esprit

• excellentes compétences verbales et écrites en anglais

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

Senior System Engineer (80 - 100%)

Zurich, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8023

Do you want to shape the future of digital workspaces in a highly dynamic enterprise environment?

Passionate about virtualization and cloud-based end-user computing? Join the Digital Workspace Virtualization team at SIX and help shape the future of digital workspaces. Based in Zurich or Warsaw.

We are an international team of experts responsible for the operation, optimisation and continuous development of solutions for our colleagues, partners and customers. You will lead by example through hands-on engineering and collaboration across teams, while consistently demonstrating the SIX values of Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership and Trust.

What You Will Do

• Technical ownership for the operation and engineering of virtual privileged access workspaces (PAW)

• Integrate identity, authentication and security requirements

• Drive the evolution from client-hosted to a scalable, centralised solution on server hypervisors

• Participate in broader virtual workspace and remote access initiatives

• Support planned out-of-hours activities and participate in on-call rotations for major incidents

What You Bring

• Expert level experience with Citrix CVAD and NetScaler in enterprise environments

• Strong experience with hardened Windows 11 golden images, identity and authentication (e.g. IdPs, PKI, FAS, FIDO2)

• Exposure to PAW/PAM systems and/or Azure Virtual Desktop

• Fluent in English (verbal and written). German and/or Spanish is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Technical Writer Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7879 As a Documentation Specialist (Technical Writer), you support participants of the electronic trading and listing platforms of Bolsas y Mercados Españoles (BME) and SIX Swiss Exchange. In close collaboration with subject‑matter experts, you prepare clear, timely communications for technical contacts at trading participants and maintain documentation products for internal and external clients. You also handle related administrative tasks. The role requires the ability to quickly understand complex topics, particularly when delivering fast and reliable information in emergency situations. You work independently and with a high degree of reliability in a complex operational environment We are seeking a Technical Writer with a Bachelor’s degree in Technical Communication, Information Technology, Finance, or a related field. The position is full-time position (100%) based in Madrid and involves close collaboration with the Documentation Team in Zurich. Willingness to travel is required. What You Will Do

This is a player-coach leadership role with direct line management responsibility for a small squad. You will remain close to the code, set technical direction for the platform, partner closely with the rest of the team to productionize what we build while partnering with other technical and business stakeholders. • Own the Data Science Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the technical strategy for the DSP on Azure Databricks, balancing platform stability, self-service capabilities, and the evolving needs of data scientists and AI engineers.
• Productize Analytics Solutions: Lead the productization of the advanced dashboarding and analytics data products, turning prototypes into reliable, well-governed, scalable data products that can be reliably consumed by end users.
• Build Self-Service Foundations: Design and operate the lakehouse architecture, data pipelines and curated models, and governance patterns (Unity Catalog, dbt, access controls) that enable analysts and scientists to work autonomously on financial data.
• Lead and Grow the Squad: Line manage and and mentor a small team of data platform engineers, set engineering standards, review design and code, and coordinate with rotating contributors to deliver against the roadmap.
• Partner Across Teams: Collaborate closely with the MLOps / Platform Engineering team on CI/CD and observability, with the AI Solutions and Productization squads on data needs, and with business stakeholders to align the platform with real analytics and self-service use cases. What You Bring
• Technical Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, Spark, Delta Lake, dbt, SQL, and Python. Solid command of lakehouse architectures, data modeling, analytics engineering practices and production-grade data pipelines.
• Platform Mindset: Proven experience designing and operating data platforms in enterprise or regulated environments, including Unity Catalog governance and cost/performance optimization.
• Player-coach Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring a small technical team while staying hands-on in architecture, implementation, code reviews, and production delivery.
• Productization & Self-Service: Experience taking analytics or data products from prototype to production and enabling self-service consumption by non-platform teams (data scientists, analysts, business users).
• Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with financial data structures and the demands of data-driven systems in complex, regulated organizations is highly desirable.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data platform roles. Relevant degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; Azure or Databricks certifications are a strong plus. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

IT & Quantitative Risk Engineering Analyst

Madrid | 100% | Riferimento 8144

Come IT & Quantitative Risk Engineering di SIX Clearing, sarai un membro chiave del nostro team di Financial Quantitative Risk Management. La vostra responsabilità primaria è garantire la stabilità, l'automazione e l'affidabilità delle piattaforme tecniche che supportano la gestione dei rischi quantitativi.

Il ruolo si concentra principalmente sull'ingegneria IT, sulle piattaforme di dati e sull'eccellenza operativa (≈70–80%), contribuendo a processi di rischio quantitativi (≈20–30%), garantendo dati e infrastrutture robuste, scalabili e di alta qualità in un ambiente mission-critical.

Cosa farai

• Progettazione, ottimizzazione e manutenzione database SQL Server (tavole, visualizzazioni, procedure memorizzate, automazione dei carichi di dati)

• Sviluppare ed eseguire tubazioni ETL basate su Python per l'ingestione, la convalida e il controllo di qualità dei dati finanziari

• Integrare e gestire i flussi di dati di mercato da fornitori esterni (ad esempio Reuters) e interni

• Costruire e mantenere processi automatizzati di calcolo del rischio che supportano i team Quant nella produzione

• Assicurare l'affidabilità della piattaforma (server di Windows, monitoraggio, patching, risoluzione incidente) e supporta ambienti containerizzati (Docker)

• Implementare e gestire le pratiche DevOps (Git, CI/CD pipelines, implementazioni automatizzate) supportando la continuità dei servizi IT critici

Che cosa porta

• Forte esperienza nell'ingegneria IT / piattaforme di dati / infrastruttura, preferibilmente in ambienti finanziari o regolamentati

• Competenze avanzate in SQL Server (modellazione dati, sintonizzazione delle prestazioni, automazione)

• Competenze di programmazione solide in Python (ETL, elaborazione dati, automazione)

• Esperienza pratica con strumenti DevOps (Git, CI/CD, containerizzazione come Docker)

• Comprensione dei dati finanziari e dei concetti fondamentali di rischio Quant, con la capacità di supportare i processi quantitativi

• Forte mentalità analitica, affidabilità sotto pressione, collaborazione e capacità di operare in ambienti mission-critical

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Tedesco Lopez Arranz al +34 91 709 5771 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT & Quantitative Risk Engineering Analyst

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8144

As an IT & Quantitative Risk Engineering of SIX Clearing, you will you will be a key member of our Financial Quantitative Risk Management team. Your primary responsibility is to ensure the stability, automation, and reliability of the technical platforms supporting quantitative risk management.

The role is primarily focused on IT engineering, data platforms, and operational excellence (≈70–80%), while contributing to quantitative risk processes (≈20–30%), ensuring robust, scalable, and high-quality data and infrastructure in a mission-critical environment.

What You Will Do

• Design, optimize, and maintain SQL Server databases (tables, views, stored procedures, automation of data loads)

• Develop and run Python-based ETL pipelines for ingestion, validation, and quality control of financial data

• Integrate and manage market data flows from external (e.g., Reuters) and internal providers

• Build and maintain automated risk calculation processes supporting Quant teams in production

• Ensure platform reliability (Windows servers, monitoring, patching, incident resolution) and support containerized environments (Docker)

• Implement and operate DevOps practices (Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments) while supporting critical IT services continuity

What You Bring

• Strong experience in IT engineering / data platforms / infrastructure, preferably in financial or regulated environments

• Advanced expertise in SQL Server (data modeling, performance tuning, automation)

• Solid programming skills in Python (ETL, data processing, automation)

• Hands-on experience with DevOps tools (Git, CI/CD, containerization such as Docker)

• Understanding of financial data and basic Quant risk concepts, with ability to support quantitative processes

• Strong analytical mindset, reliability under pressure, collaborative and ability to operate in mission-critical environments

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste d'ingénierie des risques quantitatifs et informatiques

Référence 8144

En tant qu'ingénieur des risques quantitatifs et informatiques de SIX Clearing, vous serez un membre clé de notre équipe de gestion des risques quantitatifs financiers. Votre responsabilité principale est d'assurer la stabilité, l'automatisation et la fiabilité des plateformes techniques supportant la gestion quantitative des risques.

Le rôle est principalement axé sur l'ingénierie de la TI, les plates-formes de données et l'excellence opérationnelle (de 70 à 80 %), tout en contribuant aux processus de risque quantitatifs (de 20 à 30 %), en assurant des données et une infrastructure robustes, évolutives et de haute qualité dans un environnement critique pour la mission.

Ce que vous ferez

• Conception, optimisation et maintenance des bases de données SQL Server (tableaux, vues, procédures stockées, automatisation des charges de données)

• Élaborer et exécuter des pipelines ETL à base de Python pour l'ingestion, la validation et le contrôle de la qualité des données financières

• Intégrer et gérer les flux de données du marché provenant de fournisseurs externes (par exemple Reuters) et internes

• Construisez et maintenez des processus automatisés de calcul des risques pour soutenir les équipes de production Quant

• Assurer la fiabilité de la plate-forme (serveurs Windows, surveillance, patching, résolution des incidents) et soutenir les environnements conteneurisés (Docker)

• Mettre en œuvre et exploiter les pratiques DevOps (oléoducs Git, CI/CD, déploiements automatisés) tout en soutenant la continuité des services de TI essentiels

Ce que vous apportez

• Forte expérience en ingénierie informatique / plateformes de données / infrastructure, de préférence dans des environnements financiers ou réglementés

• Expertise avancée en SQL Server (modèle de données, réglage des performances, automatisation)

• Des compétences de programmation solides en Python (ETL, traitement de données, automatisation)

• Expérience pratique avec les outils DevOps (Git, CI/CD, conteneurisation comme Docker)

• Compréhension des données financières et des concepts de base des risques quantitatifs, avec la capacité d'appuyer les processus quantitatifs

• Forte mentalité analytique, fiabilité sous pression, collaboration et capacité à fonctionner dans des environnements critiques pour la mission

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez German Lopez Arranz au +34 91 709 5771 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Sviluppatore & Integration Specialist

Varsavia | lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8150

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente cloud SAP moderno e crescere la tua esperienza di integrazione? Cerchiamo un SAP Sviluppatore e Integrazione per unire il nostro team CIT-ACI / Innovation & Technology di Varsavia, responsabile delle integrazioni edilizie, supportando le applicazioni SAP BTP e contribuendo a soluzioni basate su Fiori. Partecipa a un team che valorizza collaborazione, proprietà, innovazione.

Cosa farai

• Costruire, monitorare e mantenere integrazioni utilizzando gli strumenti SAP Integration Suite e Cloud Integration nei paesaggi aziendali

• Supporta lo sviluppo e la manutenzione di applicazioni e estensioni su SAP Business Technology Platform

• Contribuisci alle applicazioni Fiori e SAPUI5 con test, risoluzione dei problemi e miglioramenti incrementali delle funzionalità

• Collabora con architetti e sviluppatori senior per progettare soluzioni SAP scalabili, sicure e manutenbili

• Supporta l'analisi degli incidenti, la documentazione e le attività di rilascio attraverso API, interfacce e servizi cloud

Che cosa porta

• Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria o simili, con solida comprensione dei fondamenti di sviluppo software

• Conoscenza di base o forte interesse per SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Fiori o SAPUI5 tecnologie e concetti

• Comprensione di API, servizi REST, JSON e XML per scenari di integrazione in sistemi SAP e non SAP

• Fondamenti di programmazione in JavaScript, Java, Node.js o lingue simili, con problemi analitici risolvere mindset

• Forte capacità di comunicazione in inglese, con approccio strutturato e proattivo al lavoro di squadra e all'apprendimento

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Julia Schmidt al numero +41 583 994 236 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Developer & Integration Specialist

Warsaw | working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8150

Do you want to work in a modern SAP cloud environment and grow your integration expertise? We seek a SAP Developer and Integration to join our CIT-ACI / Innovation & Technology team in Warsaw, responsible for building integrations, supporting SAP BTP applications, and contributing to Fiori-based solutions. Be part of a team that values collaboration, ownership, innovation.

What You Will Do

• Build, monitor and maintain integrations using SAP Integration Suite and Cloud Integration tools in enterprise landscapes

• Support the development and maintenance of applications and extensions on SAP Business Technology Platform

• Contribute to Fiori and SAPUI5 apps with testing, troubleshooting and incremental feature enhancements

• Collaborate with architects and senior developers to design scalable, secure and maintainable SAP solutions

• Support incident analysis, documentation and release activities across APIs, interfaces and cloud services

What You Bring

• Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or similar, with solid understanding of software development fundamentals

• Basic knowledge or strong interest in SAP BTP, Integration Suite, Fiori or SAPUI5 technologies and concepts

• Understanding of APIs, REST services, JSON and XML for integration scenarios across SAP and non SAP systems

• Programming basics in JavaScript, Java, Node.js or similar languages, with analytical problem solving mindset

• Strong communication skills in English, with structured and proactive approach to teamwork and learning

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt at +41 583 994 236 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Senior Corporate Governance Consigliere Zurigo | 80-100% | Riferimento 8089 SIX sta cercando un Corporate Governance Council (100%) per contribuire a rafforzare la governance aziendale in tutto il Gruppo. Il ruolo è di anzianità di livello medio, con spazio per l'apprendimento e lo sviluppo. In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con la Direzione Legale e i team di Governance in Svizzera e Spagna. Aiuterai a plasmare gli standard di governance, sostenere la gestione delle entità legali e migliorare i processi di governance chiave in un gruppo internazionale. Il Gruppo rappresenta 70 entità, di cui 21 regolamentate da regolatori finanziari e/o banche nazionali, in Svizzera, Spagna e Regno Unito. Cosa farai
• Consiglio di sostegno e riunioni dei comitati, preparando materiali, elaborando minuti, gestendo formalità e relazioni con gli azionisti.
• Consigliare la corporate governance in tutto il Gruppo, sostenendo le questioni legali, tra cui l'allestimento, le acquisizioni e le riorganizzazione.

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Corporate Governance Counsel

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8089

SIX is looking for a Corporate Governance Counsel (100%) to help strengthen corporate governance across the Group. The role is of mid-level seniority, with room for learning and development.

In this role, you will work closely with the Head Legal Governance and the Governance teams in Switzerland and Spain. You will help shape governance standards, support legal entity management, and improve key governance processes across an international group.

The Group accounts for 70 entities, 21 of which are regulated by financial regulators and/or national banks, in, Switzerland, Spain and the UK.

What You Will Do

• Support Board and committee meetings by preparing materials, drafting minutes, managing formalities and shareholder liaisons.

• Advise on corporate governance across the Group, while supporting legal entity matters, including set-up, acquisitions, and reorganisations.

• Review and maintain governance documents by developing policies, templates, and processes, including signature authority.

• Drive governance projects and improve workflows, including the use of AI tools.

• Maintain documentation and ensure proper archiving, while also preparing memos, presentations, and deliver training to stakeholders.

What You Bring

• Have at least 5 years of corporate governance experience in Switzerland.

• Experience in establishing standards and processes across a group of legal entities incorporated in different jurisdictions.

• Write clearly, work in a structured way, and turn complex topics into practical solutions.

• Recognized as a team player with strong collaborative skills, an eye for details and pragmatism.

• Confident using Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and you are comfortable working with AI tools.

• Eager to continuously learn and develop & welcome feedback and guidance.

• Fluent in English and German.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Zurich | 80-100% | Reference 8013

Are you an experienced Treasury Manager with IT affinity? Are you familiar with the treasury related tasks in the day-to-day operations, especially cash management and FX hedging? Do you want to further develop these activities and processes and bring in your expertise? Then apply as a Treasury Manager to join our treasury team in Zurich.

Our Treasury team is looking for a Treasury Manager to support and oversee treasury operations and financial risk management activities across the organization. In this role, you will act as a key link between Treasury, Finance, Banking Partners, and other internal stakeholders. You will contribute to efficient cash and liquidity management, support strategic treasury initiatives, and help ensure transparency, compliance, and consistency across all treasury processes.

What You Will Do

• Take responsibility in the day-to-day treasury operations (e.g. cash management, bank relationship management, hedging, etc.)

• Maintain and develop the Treasury Management System

• Foster collaboration with in- and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to optimize treasury activities and processes

• Participate in strategic treasury projects of SIX Group

What You Bring

• Degree in business administration, finance/accounting or related studies, further qualifications are a plus

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in a treasury / corporate finance / cash management function, preferably in an international environment

• Solid understanding of day-to-day treasury operations such as cash and liquidity management, interest- and FX hedging, intercompany financing, liability management and bank relationship management (including KYC-documentation)

• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with excellent organizational skills

• IT affinity / experience with treasury management systems (preferably ITS from Reval/ION, SAP and 360T)

• Very good language skills in German and English (verbal and writing), Spanish is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

QA & Testing Governance Lead

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7940

If you have strong experience in QA and Test Management, combined with a structured mindset and the ability to align diverse teams around common standards, we would welcome you to join us as QA & Testing Governance Lead within Securities Services IT at SIX.
This role is part of the Program & Service Management function and is responsible for defining and driving common QA and testing governance, standards, and best practices across Securities Services IT. While Test Managers and testing roles are embedded in the different vertical areas, this position ensures a shared “common ground” and consistent quality governance across the organization.
Depending on needs and priorities, the role may also include acting as Test Manager in selected projects within the vertical areas, combining strategic governance responsibilities with hands on delivery involvement.

Does it sound interesting to you? We are looking forward to meeting you. Apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• Define, maintain and evolve QA and Testing governance, standards and best practices for Securities Services IT, with a strong focus on enabling shift‑left quality practices in close collaboration with engineering teams.

• Establish and maintain a common reference model for test phases, entry/exit criteria, go live quality gates and production readiness expectations.

• Act as the central coordination point for Test Management practices, fostering alignment and reuse of proven approaches across the different vertical areas.

• Define and standardize quality metrics, KPIs and reporting, enabling transparency, comparability and data driven decision making.

• Drive alignment of testing and test automation practices and tooling, favoring enablement models (e.g. shared baselines, self‑service approaches) over purely top‑down enforcement, while balancing standardization with context‑specific needs.

• Contribute, when required, as Test Manager in concrete initiatives or projects, supporting test planning, defect governance and go live readiness.

What You Bring

• 7+ years of hands‑on experience in QA, Test Management or Quality Governance in complex IT environments (regulated or mission‑critical contexts are a strong advantage).

• Proven experience defining and rolling out standards, governance models, processes and metrics across multiple teams or units.

• Strong understanding of test phases, testing strategies, entry/exit criteria, defect management and production readiness.

• Solid knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools and evidence‑based quality reporting, including metrics that help connect quality outcomes with delivery performance.

• Location in Spain, with willingness to travel occasionally to Switzerland.

• Fluent English (mandatory); Spanish highly valued; German a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Represent Clearing at senior internal and external forums, including the Clearing Management Committee, regulatory and industry working groups, and selected client events. What You Bring
• University degree in economics, finance, business, engineering, or a related field; advanced degree is a plus.
• Extensive experience in post-trade financial market infrastructure, clearing, exchanges, or related financial services. • You naturally build senior strategic relationships both internally and externally, translating ideas into roadmaps and operational execution. Track record of fostering strong commercial relationships with customers, partners and suppliers.
• Strong strategic, analytical, and commercial mindset, with experience owning product strategies, business cases, and growth initiatives.
• An entrepreneurial nature with an intuitive understanding of how to create value in a highly competitive business. descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci rende diversi ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Responsabile test senior

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8123

Vuoi contribuire a plasmare la qualità dei servizi business-critical in un ambiente di trasformazione dinamico e complesso? Allora unisciti a noi nel Team Test Center per le Carte, ATM & TWINT.

Garantiamo la qualità delle innovazioni e delle trasformazioni attorno alle carte di pagamento. Lavoriamo a stretto contatto con imprese, gestione dei prodotti, operazioni e partner esterni. In questo ruolo, fornire soluzioni stabili con test end-to-end strutturati e portare i nostri valori di Customer Focus, Collaborazione, ProprietÃ e Fiducia nella cooperazione quotidiana.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Pianifica, controlla e coordina test end-to-end in progetti complessi.

• Coordinate la portata, le priorità e i prossimi passi con progetti, banche, IT, operazioni e fornitori esterni.

• Coordinare i difetti, i dati di prova, gli ambienti di prova e i progressi in più flussi.

• Sviluppi ulteriormente i processi di test e garantisci la disponibilità di rilascio, consegna e consegna.

• Si assume la responsabilità di iniziative parallele e di sostenere la transizione da legacy a nuove piattaforme.

Lo porti con te.

• Hai esperienza nella gestione dei progetti di test, soprattutto nell'area delle migrazioni delle piattaforme e nel controllo di argomenti complessi in modo strutturato e decisionale.

• Porti la comprensione aziendale in carte, transazioni di transazione o transazioni di pagamento.

• Hai esperienza nelle più importanti attività di test – dai dati di prova e dalla gestione dei difetti per garantire la disponibilità e il coordinamento del rilascio.

• Ti piace lavorare con diversi stakeholder e comunicare in modo chiaro, vincolante e orientato alla soluzione.

• Si è sicuri di utilizzare strumenti di gestione dei test, idealmente Jira Xray, e anche tenere traccia di flussi multipli.

• Si comunica in modo sicuro in tedesco e inglese.

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Mateusz Kozielec su +41583998611.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What makes us different drives us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Senior Test Manager

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8123

Do you want to help shape the quality of business-critical services in a dynamic and complex transformation environment? Then join us in the Test Center Team for Cards, ATM & TWINT.

We ensure the quality of innovations and transformations around payment cards. We work closely with business, product management, operations and external partners. In this role, you provide stable solutions with structured end-to-end testing and bring our values of Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership and Trust into daily cooperation.

These are your tasks

• You plan, control and coordinate end-to-end tests in complex projects.

• You coordinate scope, priorities and next steps with projects, banks, IT, operations and external providers.

• Coordinate defects, test data, test environments and progress across multiple streams.

• You develop test processes further and ensure release, handover and handover readiness.

• You take responsibility for parallel initiatives and support the transition from legacy to new platforms.

You bring that with you

• You have experience in managing test projects, especially in the area of platform migrations, and control complex topics in a structured and decision-making manner.

• You bring business comprehension into cards, transaction processing or payment transactions.

• You have experience in the most important test tasks – from test data and defect management to ensuring go live readiness and release coordination.

• You enjoy working with different stakeholders and communicate clearly, bindingly and solution-oriented.

• You are confident in using test management tools, ideally Jira Xray, and also keep track of multiple streams.

• You communicate safely in German and English.

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Mateusz Kozielec on +41583998611.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Senior Test Manager

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Referenz 8123

Möchtest du die Qualität geschäftskritischer Services in einem dynamischen und komplexen Transformationsumfeld mitgestalten? Dann komm zu uns ins Test Center Team für den Bereich Cards, ATM & TWINT.

Wir sichern die Qualität von Innovationen und Transformationen rund um Zahlkarten. Dafür arbeiten wir eng mit Business, Produktmanagement, Operations und externen Partnern zusammen. In dieser Rolle sorgst du mit strukturiertem End-to-End Testing für stabile Lösungen und bringst unsere Werte Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership und Trust in die tägliche Zusammenarbeit ein.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du planst, steuerst und koordinierst End-to-End Tests in komplexen Projekten.

• Du stimmst Scope, Prioritäten und nächste Schritte mit Projekten, Banken, IT, Operations und externen Providern ab.

• Du koordinierst Defects, Testdaten, Testumgebungen und Fortschritt über mehrere Streams hinweg.

• Du entwickelst Testprozesse weiter und stellst Release-, Übergabe- und Handover-Readiness sicher.

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für parallele Initiativen und unterstützt die Transition von Legacy- zu neuen Plattformen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast Erfahrung in der Leitung von Testvorhaben insbesondere im Umfeld von Plattformmigrationen und steuerst komplexe Themen strukturiert und entscheidungsstark.

• Du bringst Business-Verständnis in Karten, Transaction Processing oder Zahlungsverkehr mit.

• Du hast Erfahrung in den wichtigsten Testaufgaben – von Testdaten- und Defect- Management bis zu Sicherstellen der Go Live Readiness und Release-Koordination.

• Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen und kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und lösungsorientiert.

• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Testmanagement-Tools, idealerweise Jira Xray, und behältst auch bei mehreren Streams den Überblick.

• Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Mateusz Kozielec unter der Nummer +41583998611.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Gestionnaire principal des tests

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible

Voulez-vous aider à façonner la qualité des services essentiels aux entreprises dans un environnement de transformation dynamique et complexe? Ensuite, rejoignez-nous dans l'équipe du Centre de Test pour les cartes, ATM & TWINT.

Nous assurons la qualité des innovations et des transformations autour des cartes de paiement. Nous travaillons en étroite collaboration avec les entreprises, la gestion des produits, les opérations et les partenaires externes. Dans ce rôle, vous fournissez des solutions stables avec des tests de bout en bout structurés et apportez nos valeurs de Focus Client, Collaboration, Propriété et Confiance dans la coopération quotidienne.

Ce sont vos tâches

• Vous planifiez, contrôlez et coordonnez les tests de bout en bout dans des projets complexes.

• Vous coordonnez la portée, les priorités et les prochaines étapes avec les projets, les banques, les TI, les opérations et les fournisseurs externes.

• Coordonner les défauts, les données d'essai, les environnements d'essai et les progrès sur plusieurs flux.

• Vous développez des processus de test plus loin et vous assurez la libération, le transfert et la remise de préparation.

• Vous assumez la responsabilité d'initiatives parallèles et soutenez la transition de l'héritage à de nouvelles plateformes.

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans la gestion de projets d'essai, en particulier dans le domaine des migrations de plate-forme, et contrôlez des sujets complexes de manière structurée et décisionnelle.

• Vous apportez la compréhension des affaires dans les cartes, le traitement des transactions ou les transactions de paiement.

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans les tâches de test les plus importantes – de la gestion des données de test et des défauts à l'assurance d'aller en direct et de la coordination de libération.

• Vous aimez travailler avec les différentes parties prenantes et communiquer clairement, de manière contraignante et orientée vers la solution.

• Vous communiquez en toute sécurité en allemand et en anglais.

Si vous avez des questions, visitez notre page FAQ ou contactez Mateusz Kozielec au +41583998611.

Pour cette vacance, nous ne considérons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous, et nous accueillons donc favorablement les applications sans égard à leurs antécédents personnels.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior Data Architect Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637 The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry. This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function. We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced. This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents. What You Will Do
• Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
• Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
• Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
• Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
• Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement. What You Bring
• Hands-on experience designing schemas for relational databases, messaging, data lakes/lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent), and API/message formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Strong understanding of metadata and lineage management.
• 5+ years of experience, or demonstrated delivery against requirements in data modelling, data architecture, or a closely related discipline within financial services with proficiency in UML data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar
• Strong understanding of the financial data domain: securities reference data, corporate actions, market data, and regulatory classifications, fixed income would be highly desirable
• Understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL) and schema evolution strategies for backward compatibility is essential. Direct experience of making data commercially available to AI agents is desirable.
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus. It is essential that the person in this role is able to clearly communicate complex concepts and data structures to a wide range of stakeholders. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style=" " class="buttontext buttontextc3db959e6bb5c100

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Responsabile della strategia

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8151

Il team Business Strategy si trova all'interno di Corporate Development nella funzione CFO e modella le strategie delle business unit di SIX. Si tratta di un team magra e di alta fiducia con un ampio mandato: il vostro lavoro atterra direttamente di fronte alla gestione senior, al Consiglio di Amministrazione e al Consiglio di Amministrazione. Potrai ottenere l'esposizione diretta alla leadership di SIX in tutte le business unit in anticipo, e contribuire alla strategia del Gruppo nel suo complesso.

Cosa farai

• Co-sviluppare le strategie delle business unit di SIX – aiutando a definire come e dove SIX compete e vince

• Trasformare le domande aperte in risposte chiare – analisi strutturata, un punto di vista acuto e raccomandazioni leader senior possono agire su

• Costruisci il materiale che guida le decisioni per la gestione senior, il Consiglio Direttivo e il Consiglio di Amministrazione.

• Eseguire la ricerca e l'analisi dietro di essa – mercati, paesaggio competitivo, tendenze e numeri

• Lavorare insieme alle squadre di negoziazione su M&A e le principali iniziative strategiche, dalla prima idea all'esecuzione

• Partner attraverso il business e la finanza per le idee di test di pressione e farli adottare

Che cosa porta

• Fino a 2 anni di consulenza gestionale e/o finanza aziendale / investment banking (o simile), dove hai imparato a strutturare i problemi e consegnare sotto pressione

• Uno scapolo o master in amministrazione aziendale, economia, finanza, ingegneria industriale, o un campo correlato

• Forte pensiero analitico e concettuale e un modo strutturato di lavorare attraverso sfide complesse

• Confidente con Excel e PowerPoint – è possibile costruire il modello finanziario e spiegare la storia tramite PPT

• Real curiosità su strategia, innovazione e mercati finanziari

• L'inglese fluente è essenziale; il tedesco e/o lo spagnolo è un plus.

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Strategy Manager

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8151

The Business Strategy team sits within Corporate Development in the CFO function and shapes the strategies of SIX's business units. It's a lean, high-trust team with a broad mandate: your work lands directly in front of senior management, the Executive Board, and the Board of Directors. You'll gain direct exposure to SIX's leadership across all business units early, and contribute to the strategy of the Group as a whole.

What You Will Do

• Co-develop the strategies of SIX's business units – helping define how and where SIX competes and wins

• Turn open-ended questions into clear answers – structured analysis, a sharp point of view, and recommendations senior leaders can act on

• Build the material that drives decisions for senior management, the Executive Board, and the Board of Directors.

• Run the research and analysis behind it – markets, competitive landscape, trends, and the numbers

• Work alongside deal teams on M&A and major strategic initiatives, from first idea to execution

• Partner across business and finance to pressure-test ideas and get them adopted

What You Bring

• Up to 2 years in management consulting and/or corporate finance / investment banking (or similar), where you learned to structure problems and deliver under pressure

• A bachelor's or master's in business administration, economics, finance, industrial engineering, or a related field

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking and a structured way of working through complex challenges

• Confident with Excel and PowerPoint – you can build the financial model and explain the story via PPT

• Real curiosity about strategy, innovation, and financial markets

• Fluent English is essential; German and/or Spanish is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Strategiemanager

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8151

Das Business Strategy Team sitzt innerhalb der Corporate Development in der CFO-Funktion und gestaltet die Strategien der Geschäftsbereiche von SIX. Sie werden sich frühzeitig in allen Geschäftsbereichen direkt mit der Führung von SIX vertraut machen und zur Strategie der gesamten Gruppe beitragen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Co-Entwicklung der Strategien der Business Units von SIX – Unterstützung bei der Definition, wie und wo SIX konkurriert und gewinnt

• Verwandeln Sie offene Fragen in klare Antworten - strukturierte Analysen, eine scharfe Sichtweise und Empfehlungen, auf die Führungskräfte reagieren können

• Erstellen Sie das Material, das Entscheidungen für die Geschäftsleitung, den Vorstand und den Verwaltungsrat antreibt.

• Führen Sie die Forschung und Analyse dahinter - Märkte, Wettbewerbslandschaft, Trends und die Zahlen

• Zusammenarbeit mit Deal-Teams bei M&A und wichtigen strategischen Initiativen, von der ersten Idee bis zur Umsetzung

• Partner in Wirtschaft und Finanzen, um Ideen zu testen und umzusetzen

Was du mitbringst

• Bis zu 2 Jahre in der Unternehmensberatung und / oder Corporate Finance / Investment Banking (oder ähnlich), wo Sie gelernt haben, Probleme zu strukturieren und unter Druck zu liefern

• Ein Bachelor oder Master in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft, Finanzen, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Starkes analytisches und konzeptionelles Denken und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise bei komplexen Herausforderungen

• Zuversichtlich mit Excel und PowerPoint – Sie können das Finanzmodell erstellen und die Geschichte über PPT erklären

• Echte Neugier auf Strategie, Innovation und Finanzmärkte

• Fließendes Englisch ist unerlässlich; Deutsch und / oder Spanisch ist ein Plus.

Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Gestionnaire de stratégie

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8151

L'équipe de la stratégie d'affaires siège au sein de Développement d'entreprise dans la fonction CFO et façonne les stratégies des unités d'affaires de SIX. Il s'agit d'une équipe de haute confiance et dotée d'un vaste mandat : votre travail arrive directement devant la haute direction, le conseil d'administration et le conseil d'administration. Vous serez directement exposé au leadership de SIX dans toutes les unités commerciales tôt, et contribuer à la stratégie du Groupe dans son ensemble.

Ce que vous ferez

• Co-développer les stratégies des unités commerciales de SIX – aider à définir comment et où SIX rivalise et gagne

• Transformer les questions ouvertes en réponses claires – analyse structurée, point de vue fort et recommandations

• Construisez le matériel qui motive les décisions pour la haute direction, le conseil d'administration et le conseil d'administration.

Zurich | Working from home up 40% | Referenz 8087

Möchtest du an der Schnittstelle von Banking Services, Technologie und Kundenintegration arbeiten? Motiviert es dich, Banken, Partner und interne Teams dabei zu unterstützen, sichere und stabile Services produktiv zu nutzen?

Dann freut sich unser SIX BBS Team, von dir zu hören. Wir sind verantwortlich für das Onboarding, die technische Integration und den operativen Support von Services wie DebiX API, eBill, LSV, Debit und bLink. Dein Fokus liegt auf technischen Integrationen, Kunden-Onboarding, Testing, Go-live Vorbereitung, 2nd Level Support und einer sauberen Übergabe in den regulären Betrieb.

Dies ist keine reine Projektmanager-, Product-Owner- oder Software-Engineering-Rolle. Es ist eine zentrale Schnittstellenrolle zwischen Kunden, Technologie und Betrieb.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du koordinierst technische Integrationsprojekte für DebiX API und weitere BBS Services wie eBill, Debit und ATM – von der ersten Abstimmung bis zum Go-live und zur Übergabe in den Betrieb.

• Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Banken, Kunden, Softwarepartner, Vendoren, IT-Partner und interne Teams während Onboarding, Testing, Abnahme und Produktionsvorbereitung.

• Du klärst fachliche, technische und operative Anforderungen für API-basierte Integrationen, Kundenanbindungen, Zertifikate, Umgebungen und Supportprozesse.

• Du unterstützt Testvorbereitung, Testdurchführung, Fehleranalyse, Kundenabnahmen, Go-live Aktivitäten, Hypercare und die Übergabe in den regulären Betrieb.

• Du übernimmst 2nd Level Support für Kundenanfragen, technische Schnittstellenthemen, Zertifikate, Integrationsprobleme und produktionsrelevante Incidents.

Das bringst du mit

• Erfahrung in technischer Kundenintegration, API-Integration, Partner-Onboarding, Service Integration oder technischer Projektkoordination, idealerweise im Banking, Zahlungsverkehr oder einem regulierten Umfeld.

• Gutes Verständnis von REST APIs, XML, JSON, Authentisierung, Zertifikaten, mTLS, OAuth oder vergleichbaren Sicherheits- und Schnittstellenthemen.

Ingegnere di software senior

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8108

Vuoi costruire e gestire sistemi affidabili e scalabili che alimentano servizi indici finanziari? Sei appassionato di ingegneria hands-on durante la consegna leader in un team distribuito?

Il nostro team Index ha sede a Zurigo e in India e sviluppa piattaforme principali che permettono la creazione, il calcolo e la distribuzione di indici finanziari. Lavoriamo all'incrocio tra dati, ingegneria e mercati finanziari, garantendo servizi stabili e di alta qualità per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni.

Come Ingegnere di software senior, assumerai un ruolo tecnico leader all'interno di questa configurazione distribuita, lavorando a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri in India. Mentre questo non è un ruolo di gestione delle persone, guiderà il team da una prospettiva tecnica e di consegna, assicurando che gli impegni sono soddisfatti di alta qualità e in tempo. Potrai combinare una forte ingegneria hands-on con una chiara proprietà, collaborando a stretto contatto con product manager, esperti di dominio e team SRE per costruire soluzioni affidabili ed efficaci.

Cosa farai

• Progettazione, costruzione e manutenzione di servizi backend utilizzando Java (Spring Boot) e Python per le piattaforme di calcolo e elaborazione dati indici

• Proprio la consegna end-to-end di caratteristiche, assicurandosi che vengano consegnati in tempo e soddisfare le aspettative di qualità

• Guidare la consegna tecnica di un team di ingegneria distribuito in India, allineare il team e garantire risultati coerenti e di alta qualità (senza gestione diretta della linea)

• Collaborare con i team SRE per garantire che i sistemi siano affidabili e pronti alla produzione, contribuendo a miglioramenti laddove necessario

• Guidare le decisioni di architettura e ingegneria per migliorare la scalabilità, le prestazioni e la manutenbilità

Che cosa porta

• Forte esperienza di ingegneria del software pratico con Java (Spring Boot) e Python in un ambiente di produzione

• Esperienza di consegna leader in una configurazione distribuita, con un focus su responsabilità e risultati

• Solida comprensione della progettazione del sistema backend e dei sistemi distribuiti

• Esperienza utilizzando moderni strumenti di ingegneria e sviluppo assistita da AI per migliorare la produttività e la qualità del codice

• Corso di laurea o Master in Informatica o un campo correlato, o equivalente esperienza hands-on nei sistemi di produzione di costruzione e operativi

• Capacità di comunicazione fluente inglese; tedesco è un plus

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer

Zurich | Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8108

Do you want to build and operate reliable, scalable systems powering financial index services? Are you passionate about hands-on engineering while leading delivery in a distributed team?

Our Index team is based in Zurich and India and develops core platforms that enable the creation, calculation, and distribution of financial indices. We work at the intersection of data, engineering, and financial markets, ensuring stable and high-quality services for internal and external stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will take a leading technical role within this distributed setup, working closely with engineers in India. While this is not a people management role, you will lead the team from a technical and delivery perspective, ensuring that commitments are met with high quality and on time. You will combine strong hands-on engineering with clear ownership, collaborating closely with product managers, domain experts, and SRE teams to build reliable and effective solutions.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python for index calculation and data processing platforms

• Own the end-to-end delivery of features, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet quality expectations

• Lead the technical delivery of a distributed engineering team in India, aligning the team and ensuring consistent, high-quality outcomes (without direct line management)

• Collaborate with SRE teams to ensure systems are reliable and production-ready, contributing to improvements where needed

• Drive architecture and engineering decisions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on software engineering experience with Java (Spring Boot) and Python in a production environment

• Experience leading delivery in a distributed setup, with a focus on accountability and outcomes

• Solid understanding of backend system design and distributed systems

• Experience using modern engineering tooling and AI-assisted development to improve productivity and code quality

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience in building and operating production systems

• Fluent English communication skills; German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Senior Software Engineer

Zürich | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% möglich | Referenz 8108

Möchten Sie zuverlässige, skalierbare Systeme für Finanzindexdienste aufbauen und betreiben? Haben Sie eine Leidenschaft für praktisches Engineering, während Sie die Lieferung in einem verteilten Team leiten?

Unser Index-Team hat seinen Sitz in Zürich und Indien und entwickelt Kernplattformen, die die Erstellung, Berechnung und Verteilung von Finanzindizes ermöglichen. Wir arbeiten an der Schnittstelle von Daten-, Engineering- und Finanzmärkten und gewährleisten stabile und qualitativ hochwertige Dienstleistungen für interne und externe Stakeholder.

Sie kombinieren starkes Hands-on-Engineering mit klarem Eigentum und arbeiten eng mit Produktmanagern, Domänenexperten und SRE-Teams zusammen, um zuverlässige und effektive Lösungen zu entwickeln.

Was Sie tun werden

• Design, Build und Wartung von Backend-Services mit Java (Spring Boot) und Python für Indexberechnungs- und Datenverarbeitungsplattformen

• Besitzen Sie die End-to-End-Lieferung von Funktionen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie pünktlich geliefert werden und die Qualitätserwartungen erfüllen

• Führen Sie die technische Lieferung eines verteilten Ingenieurteams in Indien, richten Sie das Team aus und gewährleisten Sie konsistente, qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse (ohne direktes Linienmanagement)

• Arbeiten Sie mit SRE-Teams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass die Systeme zuverlässig und produktionsfähig sind und bei Bedarf zu Verbesserungen beitragen

• Treiber von Architektur- und Engineering-Entscheidungen zur Verbesserung von Skalierbarkeit, Leistung und Wartbarkeit

Was du mitbringst

• Starke praktische Erfahrung mit Java (Spring Boot) und Python in einer Produktionsumgebung

• Führende Lieferung in einem verteilten Setup mit Fokus auf Rechenschaftspflicht und Ergebnisse

• Solides Verständnis von Backend-Systemdesign und verteilten Systemen

• Erfahrung mit modernen Engineering-Tools und KI-gestützter Entwicklung zur Verbesserung der Produktivität und Codequalität

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von Produktionssystemen

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch ist ein Plus

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Mateusz Kozielec unter +41583998611 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Voulez-vous construire et utiliser des systèmes fiables et évolutifs qui alimentent les services d'indice financier? Êtes-vous passionné par l'ingénierie pratique tout en menant la livraison dans une équipe distribuée?

• Conduire des décisions d'architecture et d'ingénierie pour améliorer l'évolutivité, la performance et la maintenance

• Forte expérience pratique en ingénierie logicielle avec Java (Spring Boot) et Python dans un environnement de production

• Expérience en matière de prestation de services dans une structure distribuée, l'accent étant mis sur la responsabilisation et les résultats

• Compréhension solide de la conception et de la distribution des systèmes de moteur

• Expérience d'utilisation d'outils d'ingénierie modernes et de développement assisté par l'IA pour améliorer la productivité et la qualité du code

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique ou domaine connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente dans la construction et l'exploitation de systèmes de production

• Compétences de communication en anglais; l'allemand est un plus

Data Engineer

Zurich | working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8102

SIX is recruiting a data platform engineer to work on the company wide data platform. In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for both designing and implementing a reliable platform for analytics and data science, as well as consulting internal customers who use the platform across the organization.

What You Will Do

• Be part of an international team that designs and maintains a mature cloud native data science platform, currently serving more than 14 internal analytics teams and 600+ users.

• Closely collaborate with key stakeholders from business data science teams and IT data engineering teams to enable them on the platform. Identify new requirements, analyze platform suitability, propose best practices and existing solutions through demos...

• Act as a hands-on data engineer to onboard new use cases and optimize existing ones, build production ready ETL pipelines, ML/AI use cases and reporting solutions.

• Implement new infrastructure components with Infrastructure as code (IaC), as well as creating templates to ensure best practices and standardization among analytics teams.

What You Bring

• 4+ years of practical experience building production data pipelines, data modeling and BI tools in the cloud.

• Experience with Lakehouse architecture, preferably Databricks, with a strong knowledge of Spark and Open Table formats (Delta and/or Iceberg).

• Proficiency with Python (PySpark) and SQL with a solid understanding of software development and automation concepts like CI/CD to build production data and ML pipelines (DataOps/MLOps).

• Basic knowledge of cloud foundation services (IAM, networking, storage...), cloud costs management (FinOps) as well as tools to manage cloud infrastructure with IaC (Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, bash scripting...) on Microsoft Azure (our primary cloud service provider) and/or Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform.

• Growth mindset and a very proactive attitude for continuous learning and development.

• Good presentation and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English.

• We value diversity, and the enrichment it brings to our company. We look forward to all applications, regardless of personal background.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
