Si prospera in un ambiente internazionale, globale e godere di collaborare strettamente con l'azienda per creare un impatto misurabile? Poi unisciti al nostro team internazionale di comunicazioni digitali come responsabile del marketing sociale. Il ruolo può essere basato a Varsavia (Polonia), Madrid (Spagna), o Zurigo (Svizzera). In questo ruolo, guiderai il nostro team di social media e possiederai la direzione strategica del marketing sociale pagato e organico attraverso i nostri canali. Con la vostra esperienza di leadership, mentalità strategica, e guidare per l'eccellenza, vi aiuterà a rafforzare i nostri marchi SIX e BME, elevare la nostra maturità di marketing sociale, e consentire al vostro team di agire come consulenti affidabili per il business. Investiamo nello sviluppo dei nostri leader e ti sosteniamo in continua espansione delle tue capacità e capacità. Come azienda moderna e innovativa all'incrocio tra tecnologia e finanza, SIX offre una vasta gamma di opportunità per ottenere un impatto significativo e sfruttare appieno il potenziale. Non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la tua candidatura in inglese. Cosa farai
• Guidare e allenare un team distribuito da remoto di tre specialisti dei social media, promuovendo un approccio strategico al social marketing, una mentalità di consulenza, responsabilità e una delegazione efficace.
• Proprio la strategia di marketing sociale end-to-end attraverso attività pagate e organiche, allineati con obiettivi di business e marketing.
• Stabilire e migliorare continuamente flussi di lavoro e modelli per garantire scalabilità, qualità ed efficienza attraverso la collaborazione remota.
• Agire come proprietario responsabile per i risultati del marketing sociale, traducendo gli obiettivi in KPI e prestazioni misurabili; include la gestione della crisi leader nei canali sociali quando applicabile.
• Agire come partner strategico proattivo per gli stakeholder interni e proporre soluzioni in ambienti contrattati dalle risorse. Che cosa porta
• Laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Business, Digital Media o un campo correlato, con almeno 6 anni di esperienza professionale rilevante nel marketing dei social media.
• Provata esperienza leader di team di social media remoti o virtuali, con forti capacità di leadership online, coaching e sviluppo delle persone.
• Profonda competenza nel marketing sociale strategico, comprese le campagne a pagamento, la misurazione delle prestazioni e l'ottimizzazione.
• Dimostrata capacità di allenare le squadre verso un modo consultivo di lavorare, andando oltre consegna puramente esecutiva.

Zurich, Madrid, Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8062

Are you passionate about shaping strategic social marketing at scale and leading teams through transformation? Do you thrive in an international, global environment and enjoy partnering closely with the business to create measurable impact? Then join our international Digital Communications team as Head of Social Marketing. The role can be based in Warsaw (Poland), Madrid (Spain), or Zurich (Switzerland).

In this role, you will lead our social media team and own the strategic direction of paid and organic social marketing across our channels. With your leadership experience, strategic mindset, and drive for excellence, you will help strengthen our brands SIX and BME, elevate our social marketing maturity, and enable your team to act as trusted advisors to the business.

We invest in the development of our leaders and support you in continuously expanding your skills and capabilities.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential. We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Lead and coach a remotely distributed team of three social media specialists, fostering a strategic approach to social marketing, a consultancy mindset, accountability, and effective delegation.

• Own the end‑to‑end social marketing strategy across paid and organic activities, aligned with business and marketing objectives.

• Establish and continuously improve workflows and templates to ensure scalability, quality, and efficiency across remote collaboration.

• Act as the accountable owner for social marketing outcomes, translating goals into KPIs and measurable performance; includes leading crisis management across social channels when applicable.

• Act as a proactive strategic partner to internal stakeholders and propose solutions in resource‑constrained environments.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Digital Media, or a related field, with at least 6 years of relevant professional experience in social media marketing.

• Proven experience leading remote or virtual social media teams, with strong online leadership, coaching, and people development skills.

• Deep expertise in strategic social marketing, including paid campaigns, performance measurement, and optimization.

• Demonstrated ability to coach teams toward a consultative way of working, moving beyond purely executional delivery.

• Strong process and transformation mindset, with experience building scalable ways of working in complex organizations; fluent English is required, German language skills are highly preferred but not mandatory.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Dirigez et entraînez une équipe à distance de trois spécialistes des médias sociaux, favorisant une approche stratégique du marketing social, une mentalité de conseil, la responsabilité et une délégation efficace.

• Baccalauréat en marketing, communication, affaires, médias numériques, ou un domaine connexe, avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente en marketing de médias sociaux.

• Expertise approfondie en marketing social stratégique, y compris les campagnes rémunérées, la mesure du rendement et l'optimisation.

Are you motivated by improving decision making, transparency, and accountability across IT? If so, our Information Technology team would like to hear from you. As an IT Governance Officer, you will play a central role in defining and embedding IT governance practices that align technology investments with business strategy. Acting as a trusted advisor to the CIO and IT leadership, you will help ensure that IT decisions deliver measurable value, comply with governance standards, and support long term scalability and resilience. What You Will Do
• lead the definition and maintenance of policies and frameworks for enterprise-wide IT Governance.
• support the CIO organization in steering governance, ensuring alignment with IT Governance principles, standards, and long-term scalability objectives.
• facilitate IT steering committees and governance boards, preparing decision making artefacts, documenting outcomes, and promoting accountability.
• provide expert input to senior risk and compliance committees on technology governance, operational resilience, outsourcing, and third-party risk.
• drive awareness and change initiatives to embed a strong governance culture across IT and business departments.
• promote continuous improvement within IT by encouraging standardization, documentation, and knowledge sharing across teams. What You Bring
• master’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
• relevant professional experience in IT governance, enterprise architecture, or a related discipline, ideally in a financial services or regulated environment. (The scope of responsibilities and level of autonomy will be adapted based on experience.)
• understanding of IT governance and service management frameworks such as COBIT, ITIL, and ISO 38500.
• proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments and facilitate effective decision making at senior management level.
• strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives.
• fluency in English; German or Spanish is an advantage. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Analyst Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8007 Are you passionate about market data compliance and eager to be part of the financial markets ecosystem? Do you excel in communication, influencing stakeholders, and driving meaningful change? We are looking for a dedicated team player to join our team at SIX Financial Information. In this role, you will contribute to the evolution of our entitlement platforms by gathering and documenting requirements, designing solutions, and collaborating across the organization to deliver measurable outcomes. You will work closely with user groups and the Customer Experience team, and collaborate with Product Development, Compliance, Customer Support and Operations, Project Management and Architecture. You may also engage with external partners to integrate their solutions into our platforms. This is a full-time position based in Warsaw, with up to 40% remote work as part of our hybrid working model. Join SIX and contribute to the continuous improvement of our entitlement capabilities. What You Will Do
• Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements, translating them into clear specifications, and support delivery through backlog refinement and business acceptance testing.
• Maintain and enhance platform data configurations and data lineage relevant to entitlement and authorization processes.
• Analyze and improve cross-team processes related to platform operations and customer onboarding, with a focus on standardization, automation, and efficiency.
• Provide functional support to internal and external users on entitlement topics and contribute to systematic data quality and consistency checks across connected platforms. What You Bring
• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C1 or higher), including the ability to present complex topics clearly.
• 3 or more years of experience in financial services as a Business or Data Analyst, ideally in a market data or compliance-related environment.
• Hard skills
• Solid understanding of compliance requirements related to data usage.
• Strong requirements engineering and documentation skills
• Solid data analysis capabilities (advanced Excel; SQL is a plus)
• Experience in business process analysis and modeling
• Soft skills
• Proactive and structured mindset, with a strong willingness to learn
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
• Effective collaboration and coordination skills across teams.
• Reliable team player with a pragmatic, solution-oriented approach. • sviluppare, sviluppare e approfondire relazioni a lungo termine a tutti i livelli all'interno delle organizzazioni dei clienti, compresi i soggetti senior e dirigenti.
• identificare ed eseguire in modo proattivo le opportunità di upselling e cross selling all'interno dei conti esistenti per guidare la crescita dei ricavi verso obiettivi ambiziosi.
• possedere l'onboarding di nuovi clienti e garantire una transizione senza soluzione di continuità nei nostri servizi, gettando le basi per partnership a lungo termine.
• sviluppare una profonda comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti, delle tendenze di mercato e delle dinamiche normative per anticipare le sfide e fornire soluzioni personalizzate e di valore aggiunto.
• collaborare strettamente con team interni per garantire un'elevata qualità di consegna, soddisfazione del cliente e un'esperienza cliente costantemente positiva.
• rappresentare l'azienda come senior ambassador in riunioni dei clienti, touchpoint esecutivi, eventi industriali e conferenze.
• gestire e sviluppare continuamente una robusta pipeline di vendita, fornendo previsioni accurate, reporting trasparente e una chiara visibilità sulle performance commerciali. Cosa Portare
• oltre 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle vendite e/o delle relazioni con i clienti, idealmente all'interno di servizi finanziari o un ambiente B2B complesso.
• capacità comprovata di gestire, crescere e mantenere in autonomia i portafogli dei clienti, anche portando e consegnando contro importanti obiettivi di reddito.
• forte comunicazione, negoziazione e capacità di gestione delle parti interessate, con la fiducia di impegnarsi a livello senior ed esecutivo.
• elevato livello di proprietà, responsabilità e acumen commerciale, combinato con una mentalità proattiva e orientata ai risultati.
• eccellenti competenze organizzative e la capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico e veloce.
• fluenza in inglese e tedesco richiesto; ulteriori lingue sono un vantaggio. Diese Position ist für einen erfahrenen Profi konzipiert, der mit einem hohen Grad an Autonomie arbeitet, ein signifikantes Umsatzziel verfolgt und bereit ist, Kundenbeziehungen und kommerzielle Aktivitäten aktiv zu gestalten.Was Sie tun werden
• Sie fungieren als Senior, vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für Kunden, verwalten komplexe Anfragen, kommerzielle Gespräche und Interaktionen mit Stakeholdern mit Vertrauen.
• langfristige Beziehungen auf allen Ebenen innerhalb von Kundenorganisationen aufbauen, entwickeln und vertiefen, einschließlich hochrangiger und ausführender Stakeholder.

• über 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertriebs- und/oder Kundenbeziehungsmanagement, ideal innerhalb von Finanzdienstleistungen oder einem komplexen B2B-Umfeld.

• Degree in IT or Computer Science; industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft, ITIL) are an advantage
• Proven experience as a Workplace Solution Architect in complex, regulated environments (finance or pharma preferred)
• Expertise in designing and integrating enterprise-grade solutions using M365, Exchange, SharePoint, Intune, and modern workplace technologies

• Plan, prepare, execute, and document test activities
• Manage all aspects of the QA lifecycle, including defect management & progress tracking
• Develop and maintain high-quality test artefacts using JIRA/Xray and Confluence.
• Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders.
• Estimate test efforts and support tool evaluations to optimize testing efficiency.
• Apply automation and AI-driven testing techniques to improve test coverage
• Work in Agile and SAFE environments, adapting testing practices to evolving needs.
• Manage multiple tasks and priorities while ensuring timely and high quality delivery. What You Bring
• Proven experience in managing QA activities across projects and change requests.
• Strong understanding of SW testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.
• Structured and methodical approach to testing.
• Practical experience working in Agile and SAFe frameworks.
• Hands-on experience with JIRA/Xray and Confluence for test documentation.
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. ServiceNow Soluzione Architetto Varsavia | Modello ibrido flessibile | Riferimento 7831 Vuoi modellare come ServiceNow viene utilizzato in tutta l'azienda per guidare la trasformazione? Stiamo cercando un ServiceNow Platform Architect per unire il nostro team CIT a Varsavia. In questo ruolo, si assumerà un ruolo chiave nella modellazione e nel governo dell'architettura ServiceNow in un ambiente greenfield, con influenza diretta su come la piattaforma è costruita ed evolve in tutta l'organizzazione. Progetterai soluzioni cross-module scalabili e standard di azionamento, governance e best practice in tutta la piattaforma, garantendo una configurazione sicura, conforme e futura in un ambiente regolamentato. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il proprietario della piattaforma e l'architettura aziendale come parte di un'autorità di progettazione strutturata, svolgendo un ruolo centrale nella costruzione di una solida e sostenibile piattaforma di fondazione in un complesso paesaggio aziendale. Cosa farai
• Contabile per la stabilità complessiva, le prestazioni e la sicurezza della piattaforma ServiceNow.
• Garantire l'architettura della piattaforma ServiceNow si allinea alla strategia aziendale e offre soluzioni sicure, scalabili e future.
• Definire e mantenere il piano di rilascio roadmap della piattaforma tecnica a lungo termine.
• Identificare le opportunità per massimizzare il valore degli investimenti di ServiceNow e migliorare la consegna dei servizi attraverso l'automazione e la standardizzazione.
• Definire gli standard, i modelli e la documentazione della piattaforma e l'architettura dei dati, garantendo la coerenza e l'integrità dei dati della piattaforma.
• Guide team attraverso la progettazione di soluzioni, la consegna tecnica e la strategia ambientale, garantendo l'allineamento con gli standard architettonici.
• Rafforzare la governance tecnica attraverso standard definiti e pratiche di autorità di progettazione.
• Soluzioni cross-module di progettazione in ITSM, CMDB, IRM/GRC, CSM, HRSD e relative funzionalità della piattaforma, garantendo la coerenza end-to-end e supervisionando le integrazioni.
• Definire e possedere la strategia CMDB e di modellazione dei servizi (CSDM), e supervisionare la salute CMDB.
• Agire come consulente di fiducia traducendo i requisiti aziendali in soluzioni ServiceNow efficaci e comunicare chiaramente le decisioni architettoniche e i trade-off a stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici.
• Guidare la soluzione in stretta collaborazione con Platform Owner e Enterprise Architect, garantendo l'allineamento con la governance, la sicurezza e la strategia globale della piattaforma. Che cosa porta
• Corso di laurea in Informatica, IT o un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente, idealmente all'interno di ambienti aziendali regolamentati.
• Oltre 8 anni di esperienza di ServiceNow pratico in organizzazioni complesse con requisiti di conformità e audit esigenti.
• Certificazioni ServiceNow come CSA, CAD, CIS ITSM – obbligatorie.
• Forte comprensione delle strategie di implementazione di ServiceNow e delle migliori pratiche.
• CIS CSM, CIS GRC, CIS SecOps – preferito.
• Certificazioni CTA o CMA – preferite.
• Esperienza con AI – un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza con Git – preferito.
• Prova capacità di progettare integrazioni sicure e conformi, così come flussi di lavoro su scala aziendale.
• Esperienza progettando modelli CMDB integrati con BMC Discovery in ambienti aziendali complessi e framework di governance – preferito.
• Capacità di contribuire alle recensioni di Design Authority, garantendo l'allineamento con l'architettura aziendale, la governance e la strategia di piattaforma – un vantaggio forte.
• Esperienza in ambienti altamente regolamentati – preferito.
• Capacità di comunicazione fluente inglese (scritta e parlata). Le competenze linguistiche tedesche – preferite. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero +48 538 562 645 Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. Traduzione:

We are looking for a ServiceNow Platform Architect to join our CIT team in Warsaw. In this role, you will take a key role in shaping and governing the ServiceNow architecture in a greenfield environment, with direct influence on how the platform is built and evolves across the organization. You will design scalable cross-module solutions and drive standards, governance and best practices across the platform, ensuring a secure, compliant and future-ready setup in a regulated environment. You will work closely with the Platform Owner and Enterprise Architecture as part of a structured design authority, playing a central role in building a strong and sustainable platform foundation in a complex enterprise landscape. What You Will Do
• Accountable for the overall stability, performance and security of the ServiceNow platform.
• Ensure the ServiceNow platform architecture aligns with business strategy and delivers secure, scalable and future-ready solutions.
• Define and maintain the long-term technical platform roadmap release plan.
• Identify opportunities to maximize value from ServiceNow investments and improve service delivery through automation and standardization.
• Define platform and data architecture standards, patterns and documentation, ensuring design consistency and data integrity across the platform.
• Guide teams through solution design, technical delivery and environment strategy, ensuring alignment with architectural standards.
• Enforce technical governance across the platform through defined standards and design authority practices.
• Design cross‑module solutions across ITSM, CMDB, IRM/GRC, CSM, HRSD and related platform capabilities, ensuring end-to-end consistency and overseeing integrations.
• Define and own the CMDB and service modelling strategy (CSDM), and oversee CMDB health.
• Act as a trusted advisor by translating business requirements into effective ServiceNow solutions and clearly communicating architectural decisions and trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Drive solution direction in close collaboration with the Platform Owner and Enterprise Architect, ensuring alignment with governance, security and overall platform strategy. What You Bring
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, ideally within regulated enterprise environments.
• Over 8 years of hands-on ServiceNow experience in complex organizations with demanding compliance and audit requirements.
• ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS ITSM – mandatory.
• Strong understanding of ServiceNow implementation strategies and best practices.
• CIS CSM, CIS GRC, CIS SecOps – preferred.
• CTA or CMA certifications – preferred.
• Experience with AI – a strong plus.
• Experience with Git – preferred.
• Proven ability to design secure and compliant integrations, as well as enterprise-scale workflows.
• Experience designing CMDB models integrated with BMC Discovery in complex enterprise environments and governance frameworks – preferred.
• Ability to contribute to Design Authority reviews, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, governance and platform strategy – a strong plus.
• Experience in highly regulated environments – preferred.
• Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken). German language skills – preferred. ServiceNow Solution Architekt Warschau | Flexibles Hybridmodell | Referenz 7831 Möchten Sie gestalten, wie ServiceNow unternehmensweit genutzt wird, um die Transformation voranzutreiben? Wir suchen einen ServiceNow Platform Architect, der unserem CIT-Team in Warschau beitritt. • Definieren und besitzen Sie die CMDB- und Service-Modellierungsstrategie (CSDM) und überwachen Sie die CMDB-Gesundheit.

Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. ServiceNow Solution Architecte Varsovie Modèle hybride flexible de référence 7831 Voulez-vous façonner comment ServiceNow est utilisé à travers l'entreprise pour conduire la transformation? Nous cherchons un Architecte de Plateforme ServiceNow pour rejoindre notre équipe CIT à Varsovie. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'élaboration et la gestion de l'architecture ServiceNow dans un environnement de terrain vert, avec une influence directe sur la façon dont la plateforme est construite et évolue dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. Vous concevrez des solutions multimodules évolutives ainsi que des normes, une gouvernance et des pratiques exemplaires à travers la plateforme, assurant ainsi une configuration sûre, conforme et prête à l'avenir dans un environnement réglementé. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le propriétaire de la plateforme et l'architecture d'entreprise dans le cadre d'une autorité de conception structurée, jouant un rôle central dans la construction d'une plateforme solide et durable dans un paysage d'entreprise complexe. Ce que vous ferez
• Responsable de la stabilité globale, de la performance et de la sécurité de la plateforme ServiceNow.
• Assurez-vous que l'architecture de la plateforme ServiceNow s'harmonise avec la stratégie opérationnelle et offre des solutions sûres, évolutives et prêtes à l'avenir.
• Définir et maintenir le plan de diffusion à long terme de la feuille de route technique.
• Déterminer les possibilités de maximiser la valeur des investissements de ServiceNow et améliorer la prestation des services par l'automatisation et la normalisation.
• Définir les normes, les modèles et la documentation de la plate-forme et de l'architecture des données, en assurant la cohérence de la conception et l'intégrité des données dans toute la plate-forme.
• Guider les équipes par la conception de solutions, la prestation technique et la stratégie environnementale, en assurant l'alignement avec les normes architecturales.
• Appliquer la gouvernance technique dans l'ensemble de la plateforme au moyen de normes définies et de pratiques d'autorité de conception.
• Concevoir des solutions multimodules dans l'ensemble des capacités de TISM, CMDB, IRM/GRC, CSM, RHSD et des plates-formes connexes, assurer la cohérence de bout en bout et superviser les intégrations.
• Définir et posséder la CMDB et la stratégie de modélisation des services (CSDM) et superviser la santé de la CMDB.
• Agir en tant que conseiller de confiance en traduisant les exigences opérationnelles en solutions efficaces de ServiceNow et en communiquant clairement les décisions et les compromis architecturaux aux intervenants techniques et non techniques.
• Diriger la solution en étroite collaboration avec le propriétaire de la plateforme et l'architecte d'entreprise, en assurant l'alignement avec la gouvernance, la sécurité et la stratégie globale de la plateforme. Ce que vous apportez
• Baccalauréat en informatique, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente, idéalement dans des environnements d'entreprise réglementés.
• Plus de 8 ans d'expérience pratique de ServiceNow dans des organisations complexes avec des exigences de conformité et de vérification exigeantes.
• ServiceNow certifications telles que CSA, CAD, SIC STIM – obligatoire.
• Une bonne compréhension des stratégies de mise en oeuvre et des pratiques exemplaires de ServiceNow.
• SIC CSM, SIC GRC, SIC SecOps – préféré.
• Certifications CTA ou CMA – préféré.
• Expérience avec l'IA – un plus fort.

descriptionByLocale.en: Marketing Manager (80-100%) at SIX Group in Zurich. SIX Group is an established Swiss healthcare provider. This position offers a modern working environment, attractive employment conditions and a wide range of training opportunities.
descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran. Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns. Marketing Manager (80-100%) Zurich | bis zu 40% Homeoffice möglich | Referenz 8009 Diese Rolle umfasst die Marketingverantwortung für eBill (inkl. eBill Direct Debit) an der Schnittstelle zwischen Banken, grossen Rechnungsstellern und Finanzinstituten. Sie beinhaltet die Entwicklung und Umsetzung integrierter B2B- und B2C-Marketingaktivitäten entlang des gesamten Customer Funnels sowie die Sicherstellung einer konsistenten Positionierung über alle relevanten Kanäle. Dazu gehört die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Business Development und IT, einschliesslich der Koordination relevanter Stakeholder. Das sind deine Aufgaben
• Planung und Umsetzung von B2B- und B2C-Marketingkampagnen für eBill
• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern (Produktmanagement, Business Development, IT) sowie externen Agenturen
• Erstellung und Steuerung von Content über alle relevanten Kanäle (Website, Social Media, Kampagnen, Newsletter)
• Unterstützung von Kunden bei Marketingaktivitäten (B2B2C), sowohl digital als auch klassisch (Direct Mailing, Flyers, etc.)
• Messung, Analyse und Optimierung der Kampagnenperformance anhand klarer KPIs und ROI-Ziele
• Organisation von Webinaren und Events sowie Erstellung von Präsentation und Marketingkonzepten
• Konzeption und Entwicklung von Werbemitteln, Online-Inhalten und Kommunikations-Assets (Medienmitteilungen, Blog-Artikel, Anzeigen, etc.)
• Steuerung von organischen und bezahlten Social-Media-Aktivitäten Das bringst du mit
• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich (Sozial- oder Geisteswissenschaften)
• Erfahrung im Bereich Marketing, idealerweise in einer Agentur, im Finanzumfeld oder in einem Technologieunternehmen
• Breites Verständnis des gesamten Marketing-Mix und Anwendung von OKRs
• Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit und Freude an der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit
• Starke konzeptionelle und redaktionelle Fähigkeiten in Deutsch (Muttersprache) sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
• Neugier, Eigeninitiative, unternehmerisches Denken, Proaktivität und Belastbarkeit in einem dynamischen und anspruchsvollen Umfeld Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Julia Schmidt unter der Nummer +41 583 994 236. Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen. Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Customer Support Agent Leudelange | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7853 As a Customer Support Agent, you play a key role in delivering high‑quality, timely support to customers in Luxembourg and globally, contributing to service excellence and continuous improvement within an international environment. What You Will Do
• Handle customer inquiries and incidents across SIX products and data services, ensuring timely, high‑quality resolution through end‑to‑end request handling via ticketing tools, email, calls and meetings.
• Manage and maintain operational relationships with key customers.
• Conduct root cause analysis, identify recurring issues and contribute to their sustainable resolution.
• Support business growth by engaging with new customers, products, services and SIX initiatives What You Bring
• Experience in financial markets, with exposure to asset servicing, middle/back office, market data products and regulatory topics (e.g. MiFID, ESG).
• Strong customer orientation with excellent communication and presentation skills.
• Analytical, investigative and solution‑driven mindset.
• Interest in continuous learning to support service excellence across a global product and data portfolio.
• Fluent in English and French (written and spoken); Dutch is a plus. Interest in automation and AI‑related topics is an advantage; prior AI knowledge is a plus, but not a must‑have. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. What We Offer Flexible Work Models We trust our employees and offer a work environment that is well-balanced, productive and fosters success. Personal Development You will benefit from a culture of continuous learning and feedback. Your personal growth is supported through an extensive learning offering. Agile Working Methods Whether through scrum or design thinking, we solve exciting tasks together in teams. Apply now » </d

SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior Data Scientist Warsaw, Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7592 Join our Data Science, Analytics, and AI team at SIX BFI, a leader in the financial data industry. We are looking for a passionate and experienced Senior Data Scientist to drive the development of innovative AI-powered solutions. You will work on a wide range of initiatives, from extracting intelligence from unstructured data to building production-grade analytical applications. If you are a proactive, hands-on leader who thrives on solving complex challenges and wants to make a significant impact, this is the role for you. What You Will Do
• Lead AI/Analytics Projects: Owns the end-to-end lifecycle of data science projects, from ideation and stakeholder engagement to deployment and iteration, ensuring alignment with business goals.
• Develop Advanced AI/ML Models: Leverage cutting-edge AI, NLP, and machine learning techniques to extract structured insights from unstructured financial documents and alternative data sources.
• Build Production-Ready Solutions: Design, build, and deploy robust, production-grade AI solutions, including analytical chatbots and critical applications that deliver actionable insights from our vast datasets.
• Act as a Data Evangelist: Develop a deep understanding of our vast financial datasets and act as a subject matter expert, collaborating directly with business stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
• Collaborate and Mentor: Work closely with cross-functional teams of engineers, product managers, and other data scientists. Mentor junior team members and foster a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning. What You Bring
• Technical Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python and its data science ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, spaCy). Extensive experience with Databricks, PySpark, and dbt for large-scale data processing and transformation.
• API and Backend Skills: Proven experience building production-ready APIs using frameworks like FastAPI and interacting with databases using tools like SQLAlchemy.
• DevOps & MLOps Mindset: Strong understanding of software development best practices. Hands-on experience with Docker for containerization and Git for version control. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <style type="text/

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Project Management Officer Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7958 We are looking for an experienced Project Management Officer (PMO) to strengthen the delivery and governance of projects within SIX Securities Services, a leading provider of post trade services in the financial industry. This role sits within the Business Support department and acts as an internal consulting function, supporting project teams and senior stakeholders to ensure high quality, on time and on budget project delivery across a complex and regulated environment. As part of the team you will work in an international financial services environment, contributing to the continuous development of project management capabilities while supporting strategic initiatives with real business impact. Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English. We are looking forward to hear from you. What You Will Do
• Plan, monitor and control project deliverables, milestones and KPIs, mantaining and structured project communication and stakeholder management
• Support and coordinate project team meetings, project boards, workshops and steering committees
• Perform project controlling activities, including financial reporting and actively manage RAID topics (Risks, Assumptions, Issues and Decisions)
• Define, maintain and continuously improve project management methods, standards, documentation and templates
• Collaborate in the harmonisation, optimisation and innovation of project management processes and support the onboarding of new employees into the division’s project environment
• Capture lessons learned and proactively propose improvements What You Bring
• University degree in IT, finance, business management or any related field. PMP or PRINCE 2 certifications will be valuable.
• At least 5 years of experience in a Project Management Office or similar role
• Solid project management skills, including agile methodologies (e.g. Scrum) . Jira/Confluence
• Good understanding of financial services, banking and/or insurance processes is an advantage
• Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills with a proactive, structured and result oriented mindset with also a strong customer focus
• Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style=" " class="buttontext buttontextdaaac1fecd1a5554 rtltextaligneligible

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Development & Strategy Specialist Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7587 SIX Securities Services are powers the core post-trade infrastructure for Swiss, Spanish and international markets. From clearing and settlement to custody and collateral management, we ensure securities transactions are processed safely, efficiently, and reliably across markets. BSS runs interoperable CCP and CSD platforms, connects participants worldwide, and delivers value-added services that support banks, brokers, and institutional investors throughout the full post-trade lifecycle. Our Business Development & Strategy team sits within the BSS COO organization, which spans all products and drives strategy execution, transformation, and performance. We complement the product and business development experts in each product vertical and are responsible for executing strategy across BSS and unlocking new growth. We lead transversal initiatives, cultivate strategic partnerships, and identify cross-Business Unit synergies. Our remit includes shaping and executing M&A, steering priority strategic programs, and turning data into action through business intelligence and analytics. We also enable our commercial teams with strategic sales support to maximize market impact. As a Business Development & Strategy Specialist, you’ll help shape the future of SIX Securities Services by driving initiatives that span the entire post-trade value chain. You’ll operate at the intersection of strategy, business development and market intelligence—translating ideas into tangible growth and supporting execution across all product areas (Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance, and Trade Repositories). This high-visibility role offers close collaboration with senior leadership, product teams and external partners—giving you a front-row seat to influence direction and deliver measurable results. What You Will Do
• Shape and drive strategic growth initiatives across the Securities Services value chain – connecting the product verticals Clearing, Custody, Securities Finance and Trade Repositories into integrated, client-centric solutions.
• Translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives by developing business cases, coordinating stakeholders across product verticals and Business Units (Exchanges, Financial Information and Banking Services) and supporting execution.
• Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify trends, client needs and partnership opportunities that impact and enhance SIX’s positioning as leading European Financial Market Infrastructure
• Support strategic projects and M&A activities, including opportunity assessment, due diligence and integration preparation.
• Develop management insights and communication materials – dashboards, presentations, and reports – to enable informed decisions and track progress on strategic initiatives. What You Bring
• Educational background in finance, economics or business administration with strong understanding of financial service industry and trends
• A minimum of 3 years of experience in capital markets, financial market infrastructure or securities services, ideally in clearing, settlement, custody, securities finance incl. collateral management or trade repositories. Relevant work experience in consulting, corporate strategy or investment banking is a plus
• Strong analytical, conceptual and strategic thinking skills with proven ability to translate complex market and business insights into actionable plans, combined with excellent problem-solving, communication and presentation skills, capable of engaging both internal management and external partners
• Structured and proactive working style, comfortable coordinating multiple stakeholders across business lines, locations, and hierarchies
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing); German and/or Spanish as a plus If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style=" " class="buttontext buttontextfbe84cb3b14a5450 rtltextaligneligible ce

Senior Corporate Administration Lead London | hybrid working 60/40 | Reference 7954 Job Introduction Are you driven by strong governance and confident operating in regulated environments? Do you enjoy combining strategic oversight with hands on delivery? REGIS-TR are looking for a Senior Corporate Administration Lead to sit at the heart of the organisation’s governance and regulatory framework, working closely with senior leaders, the Board and external partners. The role offers high visibility and real influence, spanning corporate governance, outsourcing oversight, claims management and risk. You will lead critical processes, ensure regulatory compliance and drive continuous improvement, while acting as a trusted adviser across the business and delivering assurance with precision and judgement. What You Will Do • Manage financial oversight and supplier relationships, including invoice validation, payment reconciliation, tax compliance, banking arrangements and effective vendor controls. • Lead the outsourcing framework, owning policy implementation, managing third party providers, managing contracts, and monitoring performance against regulatory and service standards. • Own claims management and risk oversight, acting as the focal point for claims activity and leading the annual Corporate Affairs risk review and mitigation planning. • Act as a key Corporate Affairs partner for REGIS-TR, working with internal and external stakeholders to ensure regulatory compliance, including regular and ad-hoc FCA reporting, and smooth delivery of governance priorities. • Manage the annual accounts process, coordinating with Finance colleagues and the statutory auditor to ensure that the annual accounts and Directors’ report are prepared and approved according to agreed timescales What You Bring • University degree in economics, finance, banking and/or a comparable education • While not essential, knowledge of SAP would be considered a distinct advantage • Superb organisational skills, flexible, result oriented, fast acting • Excellent communication skills; customer and service orientation • Language: Fluent English mandatory; knowledge of an additional language would be advantageous (particularly German or Spanish) If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. Business Analyst Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7639 Introduction Do you like working close to real data and seeing the impact of your work in production? In this role, you help keep our products running on clean, timely, and trusted reference data. You work hands on with data sources from onboarding to release and make sure they are mapped, validated, and ready for use. You take real ownership, work on data that matters, and quickly build strong expertise in areas like identifiers, taxonomies, and data quality. This is a great role if you enjoy combining analysis, structure, and practical execution. What you will do
• Gather and document requirements for instrument and issuer reference data
• Analyse data feeds and define mappings, data models, and rules to build a reliable golden copy
• Implement validation checks, reconciliation, and controls including handling of duplicates and exceptions
• Ensure secure data transfer and manage ongoing data changes
• Identify risks early and drive improvements or automation opportunities
• Collaborate with Product, IT, and Operations, and support testing, documentation, and releases What you will bring
• 2 to 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst in financial or reference data
• Solid understanding of instrument and issuer master data concepts
• Experience working with multiple data sources and aligning them into a consistent view
• Hands-on experience with validation, reconciliation, and exception handling
• Ability to write clear specifications and acceptance criteria and work with common data formats (CSV, JSON, XML) and tools
• Strong analytical and technical skills (SQL, advanced Excel, basic Python), familiarity with Jira and Confluence, and clear communication in English If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

IT Solution Designer Warsaw, Madrid | Working form home up to 40% possible | Reference 7776 Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? Are you passionate about architecture and technology? Join our growing Architecture Practice as an IT Solution Designer / Application Architect supporting our dynamic teams, shaping the architecture of applications as we transform to meet the ever-evolving demands of our products and business. We are looking for a professional driven by passion for data, technology transformation, and cross-functional collaboration. As a member of our Architecture team, your influence will not just shape the architecture and our engagement across the department, but also help chart the course for our future state. What You Will Do:
• Design, drive, and maintain end‑to‑end solution architectures in close collaboration with Senior Architects, development teams, and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment with target architecture, principles, standards, and governance.
• Shape and evolve the future‑state architecture and technology roadmap across the landscape, contributing to strategic architectural decisions and long‑term modernization initiatives.
• Support SAFe System Architects within Agile Release Trains by establishing and maintaining the architectural runway to enable continuous delivery, architecture evolution, and emerging business demands.
• Build strong, trust‑based relationships with business stakeholders, developers, and fellow architects to translate business needs into robust, scalable, and well‑documented architectural solutions.
• Ensure adherence to enterprise architecture standards, security, risk, and regulatory requirements, while supporting technology evaluations and the design and delivery of proofs of concept and prototypes. What you will bring:
• 3+ years in a technical leadership capacity, 5+ years in an architecture capacity, with experience in the global financial services sector, particularly in Financial Information and high-volume Data Management at scale a plus
• Good knowledge of diverse technologies and solution architecture patterns, and with a drive for innovation. Experience with both on-premise and Cloud technologies and architecture paradigms, and the trade-offs between them.
• Understanding of AI technologies, integration patterns and emerging standards, and the foundational capabilities to enable AI growth and adoption
• Proficiency in English is mandatory, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Spanish and German is an advantage
• A vibrant personality and natural collaborator, with the capability to work across diverse teams, and foster strong, extended connections If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec at +41583998611 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. descriptionByLocale.it: SIX ci spinge alla trasformazione dei mercati finanziari. descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior Sales Manager London | hybrid working 60/40 | Reference 7964  Do you want to work in a fast-moving, client-facing market environment? SIX Financial Information is seeking a commercially driven, client-centric Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts within our Financial Information business in the UK market. This is a quota-bearing role focused on deepening client relationships, driving retention and expansion, and delivering sustainable revenue growth across an existing client base. You will act as the senior relationship owner for a defined portfolio of growth and priority accounts, building strong partnerships with key stakeholders across the buy- and sell-side. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of financial market workflows across front, middle, and back office functions, and the ability to translate SIX Financial Information’s product suite into clear, tangible commercial value. What You Will Do
• Own and develop senior client relationships across a portfolio of complex accounts, acting as the primary trusted advisor to key stakeholders
• Lead strategic account planning, defining short- and long-term growth strategies to drive retention, revenue expansion, and minimise churn
• Manage the full commercial lifecycle, including renewals, pricing, negotiations, and contract execution
• Identify and execute upsell and cross-sell opportunities, increasing deal size and overall client adoption
• Build and maintain a high-quality pipeline with accurate forecasting, pipeline coverage tracking, and path-to-goal analysis
• Engage in consultative, solution-led selling by translating client workflows and data needs into value propositions, whilst acting as the voice of the client internally What You Bring
• 5+ years’ experience in account management or sales within financial information, market data, or a related industry, with a proven quota track record
• Strong understanding of financial markets, including buy-side and sell-side workflows and data requirements
• Experience managing complex institutional clients and navigating multi-stakeholder environments effectively
• Strong consultative and solution-selling skills, with the ability to articulate clear value propositions
• Excellent relationship management, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills across all organisational levels
• Proactive, organised, and results-driven approach, with strong pipeline management discipline and ability to collaborate across international teams If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Senior IT Business Manager Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8052 Il CIO Office di SIX supporta il CIO nel guidare l'organizzazione IT con chiarezza, attenzione e impatto. Al suo centro, l'Ufficio traduce la strategia IT in esecuzione, assicura trasparenza e allineamento attraverso l'IT e guida la consegna di iniziative chiave di trasformazione. Il ruolo di Senior IT Business Manager è una posizione centrale, volutamente ampia all'interno di questa configurazione. Offre l'opportunità di operare all'incrocio tra strategia, governance e esecuzione, con esposizione diretta al CIO e leadership senior. Cosa farai
• CIO Enablement & Executive Steering: Sostenere il CIO in argomenti chiave IT, compresa la preparazione di materiali decisionali, presentazioni di gestione e narrazioni strategiche
• Governance & Leadership Support: Orchestrare e preparare forum di governance chiave (ad esempio, formati di Consiglio e leadership) e garantire il follow-up e la trasparenza strutturati.
• Esecuzione di strategia: contribuire attivamente all'esecuzione della strategia IT e di trasformazione, compresa la gestione di iniziative interfunzionali.
• Orchestrazione interfunzionale: Collegare e coordinare gli argomenti tra le unità IT e business, tra cui la gestione delle dipendenze, delle priorità e delle escalation.
• Argomenti strategici e operativi Ad-hoc: Guidare e fornire una vasta gamma di argomenti “CIO Enablement” (ad esempio, mandati, RfP, workshop, formati di comunicazione) con alta visibilità e impatto.
• Consegna a mano attraverso i livelli: Capacità di passare tra discussioni strategiche di alto livello e esecuzione operativa dettagliata mantenendo la consistenza end-to-end. Che cosa porta
• Laurea universitaria (tecnologia, affari o simili), B.A. o superiore.
• 5-10 anni di esperienza professionale, idealmente in ambienti IT, strategia o trasformazione.
• Prove capacità di impegnarsi e collaborare con gli stakeholder senior combinati con una comunicazione chiara ed efficace.
• Hands-on, strutturato e pragmatico approccio con un forte atteggiamento “can-do” e la capacità di guidare in modo indipendente argomenti per i risultati.
• Alto impegno e motivazione, spiccata disponibilità ad assumersi la responsabilità.
• La fluenza in inglese è un must; il tedesco è un plus. Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale. <span class="fontcolorfe3104f33e8bf462"

• Exécution pratique à tous les niveaux : Capacité de passer de discussions stratégiques de haut niveau à une exécution opérationnelle détaillée tout en maintenant l'uniformité de bout en bout. Ce que vous apportez

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Quality Assurance Engineer Madrid | Work from home up to 40% | Reference 7648 Do you want to be part of a dynamic environment where software quality is a top priority? Are you passionate about ensuring robust, reliable, and high‑performance products? If so, our quality team wants to hear from you! We are an agile team focused on ensuring that our solutions meet the highest quality standards. We are responsible for validating key functionalities, automating tests, and continuously improving our testing processes. Our goal is to deliver an impeccable user experience and guarantee product stability in every release. In this role, you will work closely with developers, product owners, and other QA engineers, participating in the entire development lifecycle to ensure quality from day one. What You Will Do
• Design, execute, and automate backend and end‑to‑end tests using Java and JavaScript, ensuring the quality and stability of developed services.
• Validate data‑processing microservices architectures, including Spark‑ and Cloudera‑based components, as well as Kafka integrations and data consolidation/transformation checks.
• Perform and analyze performance tests using JMeter, identifying improvement areas, detecting potential bottlenecks, and producing detailed technical reports.
• Manage and document the full testing lifecycle using Xray: test case design, sprint execution, incident tracking, and functional/technical certification of releases.
• Collaborate continuously with development, business, and monitoring teams, providing technical documentation in English and defining validation procedures for deployments to production environments What You Bring
• Strong technical skills in Java and JavaScript, with proven experience in test automation using the Karate framework to ensure backend service quality and consistency.
• Solid knowledge of backend ecosystems and data‑driven environments, including Kafka integrations, Spark‑based pipeline development and validation, and experience with data‑management platforms such as Cloudera.
• Demonstrated experience with quality assurance tools and methodologies, particularly continuous integration with GitLab, performance testing with JMeter, and test lifecycle management using Xray.
• Ability to develop supporting automation scripts in Python to streamline tasks and support various testing frameworks.
• Excellent communication and documentation skills in English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with development teams, business areas, and international stakeholders in agile environments. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <style type=

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa. Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi. Palazzo BME Eventi Stage (Parcheggio del pomeriggio) Madrid | Modello di lavoro flessibile | Riferimento 8084 Stai studiando e hai competenze nel campo della gestione degli eventi, della comunicazione e delle relazioni pubbliche? Sei interessato al settore Comunicazione e Marketing e alla ricerca di un interessante stage per saperne di più sul settore finanziario? Se la vostra risposta è sì, il nostro team Eventi e Conferenze, responsabile di eventi e visite guidate al Palacio de la Bolsa, vi incontrerà. Siamo alla ricerca di una persona luminosa e dedicata che si diverte a lavorare in una squadra e vuole fare uno stage pomeridiano a BME, dove fornire assistenza pratica nella zona Eventi e Conferenze. La funzione si baserà al Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1). Non esitare e applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese. Cosa farai
• effettuare le visite guidate, supervisionare la casella di posta e rispondere alle richieste di visite guidate, amministrare e gestire tutte le richieste in arrivo (mail / telefono)
• collaborazione nello sviluppo dei materiali e dei discorsi per le visite guidate, acquisendo conoscenze e storia legate al mercato azionario e ai suoi dintorni (Stock Exchange Palace)
• sostenere i responsabili degli eventi in tutti gli aspetti della gestione degli eventi (pianificazione, preparazione, esecuzione, materiale evento, gestione degli inviti e registrazione, ecc.)
• fornire supporto ad hoc al team eventi nel loro lavoro quotidiano
• supporto on-Site agli eventi Che cosa porta
• studi in Marketing, Comunicazione, Turismo, Amministrazione Bussines o Organizzazione Evento e disponibilità per i pomeriggi (da 14 a 19h Lunedì a Venerdì)
• capacità di lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e globale con eccellenti capacità organizzative e di comunicazione
• forti capacità organizzative e flessibilità personale
• disponibilità a collaborare e lavorare autonomamente abbinato a buone capacità di gestione del tempo
• ottimo livello di inglese e spagnolo parlato e scritto (minimo B2)
• esperienza nell'hosting degli eventi virtuali è un vantaggio Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 . Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette in inglese. La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Palace BME Events Internship (Afternoon Schedule) Madrid | Flexible Working Model | Reference 8084 Are you studying and do you have skills in the field of events management, communication and public relations? Are you interested in the Communication and Marketing sector and looking for an interesting internship to learn more about financial sector? If your answer is yes, our Events and Conferences team, responsible for events and guided tours at the Palacio de la Bolsa, would like to meet you. We are looking for a bright and dedicated person who enjoys working in a team and wants to do an afternoon internship at BME, where you will provide hands-on assistance in the Events and Conferences area. The function will be based at the Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1). Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English. What You Will Do
• carry out the guided tours, oversee mailbox and answer inquiries for guided tours, administrating and managing all incoming requests (mail/telephone)
• collaboration in the development of the materials and speeches for the guided tours, acquiring knowledge and history related to the stock market and its surroundings (Stock Exchange Palace)
• support the event managers in all aspects of event management (planning, preparing, execution, event material, invitation and registration management, etc.)
• provide ad hoc support to the events team in their daily work
• on-Site support at events What You Bring
• studies in Marketing, Communication, Tourism, Bussines Administration or Event Organization and availability for the afternoons (from 14 to 19h Monday to Friday)
• ability to work in a dynamic and global environment with excellent organizational and communication skills
• strong organizational skills and personal flexibility
• willingness to collaborate and work autonomously paired with good time management skills
• very good level of spoken and written English and Spanish (B2 minimum)
• experience in hosting virtual events is an advantage If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

• Durchführung der Führungen, Überwachung der Mailbox und Beantwortung von Anfragen für Führungen, Verwaltung und Verwaltung aller eingehenden Anfragen (Mail / Telefon)

• Unterstützung der Eventmanager in allen Aspekten des Eventmanagements (Planung, Vorbereitung, Durchführung, Eventmaterial, Einladungs- und Registrierungsmanagement etc.)
• Ad-hoc-Unterstützung des Events-Teams bei der täglichen Arbeit
• On-Site-Support bei Veranstaltungen Was du mitbringst
• Studien in Marketing, Kommunikation, Tourismus, Bussines Administration oder Veranstaltungsorganisation und Verfügbarkeit für die Nachmittage (von 14 bis 19 Uhr Montag bis Freitag)
• Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen und globalen Umfeld mit hervorragenden Organisations- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zu arbeiten
• starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und persönliche Flexibilität
• Bereitschaft zur Zusammenarbeit und autonomen Arbeit gepaart mit guten Fähigkeiten im Zeitmanagement
• sehr gutes Sprach- und Schriftniveau Englisch und Spanisch (B2 Minimum)
• Erfahrung im Hosting virtueller Events ist von Vorteil Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Sara Perez de la Cuesta unter +34 91 709 56 80 an. Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen in englischer Sprache. Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe. Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous. Palais BME Événements Stage (horaire de l'après-midi) Référence 8084 Êtes-vous étudiant et avez-vous des compétences dans le domaine de la gestion des événements, de la communication et des relations publiques? Êtes-vous intéressé par le secteur Communication et Marketing et à la recherche d'un stage intéressant pour en savoir plus sur le secteur financier? Si votre réponse est oui, notre équipe Événements et Conférences, responsable des événements et visites guidées au Palacio de la Bolsa, aimerait vous rencontrer. Nous sommes à la recherche d'une personne brillante et dévouée qui aime travailler en équipe et veut faire un stage de l'après-midi au BME, où vous fournirez une assistance pratique dans le domaine des événements et des conférences. La fonction sera basée au Palacio de la Bolsa de Madrid (Plaza de la Lealtad, 1). N'hésitez pas et appliquez maintenant avec votre CV en anglais. Ce que vous ferez
• effectuer les visites guidées, superviser la boîte aux lettres et répondre aux demandes de visites guidées, administrer et gérer toutes les demandes reçues (courrier/téléphone)
• collaboration dans le développement des matériaux et des discours pour les visites guidées, l'acquisition de connaissances et l'histoire liées à la bourse et à ses environs (Stock Exchange Palace)
• soutenir les gestionnaires d'événements dans tous les aspects de la gestion d'événements (planification, préparation, exécution, matériel d'événements, gestion des invitations et des inscriptions, etc.)
• fournir un soutien ad hoc à l'équipe des événements dans son travail quotidien
• soutien sur site lors des manifestations Ce que vous apportez
• études en Marketing, Communication, Tourisme, Bussines Administration ou organisation d'événements et la disponibilité pour les après-midi (de 14 à 19h du lundi au vendredi)
• capacité à travailler dans un environnement dynamique et mondial avec d'excellentes compétences en matière d'organisation et de communication
• compétences organisationnelles solides et flexibilité personnelle
• la volonté de collaborer et de travailler de manière autonome, associée à de bonnes compétences en gestion du temps
• très bon niveau d'anglais et d'espagnol parlé et écrit (B2 minimum)
• l'expérience dans l'hébergement d'événements virtuels est un avantage Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 . Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes en anglais. La diversité est importante pour nous. descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Senior AI Backend Engineer Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7655 Join SIX Financial Information's AI Engineering team as a Senior AI Backend Engineer of our Productization squad. You will own the backend, APIs, and integrations that turn AI prototypes into production-grade products in our GenAI and Data Mining lines. This is a high-leverage, player-coach role at the heart of how we scale AI delivery. You will set the technical direction for production-grade engineering, partner with data scientists and AI engineers on serving and integration patterns, and free the AI Solutions team to focus on models and evals while your squad owns reliable delivery to end users What You Will Do
• Productize AI & GenAI Solutions: Build the backends, agent/RAG infrastructure, MCP servers, and LLM-serving layers that turn models, prompts, and pipelines into reliable, observable production products.
• Design & Build Production APIs: Architect and maintain endpoints and GraphQL APIs, defining schema, resolver, and authentication patterns that serve frontend applications, internal services, and AI features.
• Integrate Data & AI Pipelines: Develop ingestion, parsing, OCR, and vendor-LLM integrations (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) with strong attention to concurrency, async processing, retries, idempotency, and state-machine workflows.
• Operate in Production: Partner with MLOps on Docker, Terraform, and Azure DevOps CI/CD; establish performance baselines and observability for both APIs and AI workloads; optimize for latency, throughput, and cost.
• Champion Quality & Coach Peers: Apply clean architecture and proven design patterns, enforce standards through tests and reviews, and coach junior engineers and rotating contributors. What You Bring
• Backend Expertise: Deep proficiency in Python and hands-on experience designing and scaling modern APIs (e.g. FastAPI) in production, including async/await for I/O-bound workloads. Production experience with GraphQL (Strawberry or comparable) is a strong plus.
• AI Productization Experience: Hands-on experience integrating LLMs and AI APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) into production systems, with familiarity in RAG, agent frameworks, vector databases, MCP, or ML serving patterns.
• Data & Persistence: Strong production experience with PostgreSQL, SQLModel/SQLAlchemy, and Alembic, including schema design, indexing, and efficient queries.
• Cloud & DevOps: Solid working experience with Google Cloud Platform and/or Azure, Terraform, Docker, Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab or equivalent).
• Quality & Collaboration: Strong testing discipline with pytest, a habit of writing maintainable, well-typed code, and the communication skills to mentor peers and partner closely with data scientists and AI engineers.
• Experience & Education: 5+ years in Backend Development, Software Engineering, or Systems Architecture, including significant experience designing and operating production systems. A relevant degree in Computer Science or related field is required. English fluency is required. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. window.youtubevideos = window.youtubevideos || []; window.youtubevideos.push({'src':

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Product Owner Warsaw | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7635 We’re looking for a Product Owner to join our Product Platforms team and own the product backlog for systems that ingest, normalize, enrich, and process content. You’ll collaborate across engineering, architecture, content operations, data governance, and product stakeholders to deliver capabilities that enable downstream products. You will operate within SAFe, working primarily with an Agile team (or teams) within an Agile Release Train (ART), translating platform strategy into clear outcomes, stories, and increments. What You Will Do
• Own and prioritize the team backlog aligned to ART objectives.
• Author epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria, non-functional requirements (NFRs)
• Maintain a transparent roadmap and release plans
• Participate in PI Planning, define team objectives, and sequence features for maximum value delivery.
• Lead backlog refinement, iteration planning, daily scrums, system demos, and Inspect & Adapt workshops.
• Collaborate with Product Managers, System Architect, Engineering teams, and RTE to ensure alignment and architectural runway. What You Bring
• 2-5 years in Product Ownership/Management for data platforms, content systems, or integration-heavy products.
• Hands-on experience working in SAFe or large-scale agile environments;
• Background in content ingestion/processing (e.g., feeds, files, APIs), Stream processing, ETL/ELT, and workflow orchestration would be a plus
• Familiarity with data quality frameworks, metadata/cataloging, and content normalization
• Ability to define NFRs (performance, reliability, security) and collaborate on SLOs design
• Excellent communication skills; proven stakeholder management, professional English is a must, German an advantage. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div class="customPlugin customPlugin-62e56ac1968a01

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets. What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Business Analyst - Market Data Warsaw | 80-100% | Reference 7666  Are you ready to work at SIX and join the world of Finance and IT? Do you enjoy breaking down problems, working with data, and learning how technology supports business outcomes? Apply as a Business Analyst to join our international, fun and dynamic team, where you will support analysis activities and grow your skills with guidance from experienced colleagues. What You Will Do
• support analysis activities for data initiatives (market data), assisting with requirements gathering and helping translate business needs into clear, structured documentation
• help maintain data mappings and transformation rules (normalization, enrichment, identifiers) under guidance, and contribute to keeping documentation accurate and up to date
• support the documentation of API and messaging-based integrations for real-time and batch delivery, learning key concepts and assisting with interface specifications
• contribute to acceptance criteria and support testing activities (e.g., test cases, data checks) for data pipelines and data products
• work with senior analysts and delivery teams as an interface to stakeholders, supporting backlog refinement, capturing actions, and helping clarify requirements in an agile, international environment What You Bring
• bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (or equivalent practical experience) and initial experience (up to 2 years) in a Business Analyst, data, technology, or operations role preferably in Financial Services
• basic understanding of real-time and batch data delivery concepts, with interest in API/data integration patterns (e.g., REST, message buses) and willingness to learn on the job
• interest in market data and financial instruments/identifiers, and an understanding of the data lifecycle (ingest, normalize, store, distribute); able to support impact assessments for supplier or source changes
• ability to validate and analyze data, with confidence working with spreadsheets and large datasets; SQL or similar querying skills are an advantage
• familiarity with requirements/specification techniques (e.g., user stories, use cases) and attention to detail when documenting mappings and transformation rules
• comfortable working in an agile environment and using common BA tools and methods, with strong communication skills and the ability to ask the right questions; fluency in English (French is a plus) If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <scr

• Familiarity with fund data intake, validation, and dissemination workflows.
